author.name_en: Abu 'Abd Allah Sufyan b. Sa'id b. Masruq al-Thawri al-Kufi (the authority whose hadith is collected); transmitted by al-Sari b. Yahya (Part One) and Muhammad b. Yusuf al-Firyabi (Part Two)
author.name_ar: أبو عبد الله سفيان بن سعيد بن مسروق الثوري الكوفي

notes.label: Edition
notes.text: Dar al-Bashair al-Islamiyya [Series of Hadith Parts and Books, no. 31], First edition, 2004 CE

notes.label: Numbering
notes.text: Shamela states that its numbering matches the printed edition. Numbers 1-211 are Part One and 212-321 are Part Two; the last five reports (317-321) are appended with other chains. The edition marks the editor's own insertions in square brackets.

notes.label: Structure of the work
notes.text: A printed critical edition of two transmissions of the hadith of Sufyan al-Thawri. Part One (1-211) is the manuscript of al-Sari b. Yahya's transmission (compare Shamela book 29701), with the editor's bracketed restorations of missing words and reports; its English matns were carried over from the manuscript-text edition where the Arabic is the same and retranslated where the printed Arabic differs (reports 7, 10, 11, 68, 72, 110, 127, 172, 182, 211). Part Two (212-321) is the transmission of Muhammad b. Yusuf al-Firyabi, which opens with a chain of transmission of the copy, followed by reports that continue 'Sufyan narrated to us:' and give only the chain from Sufyan's teacher onward. There are no chapter headings.

notes.label: English translation
notes.text: The English is the supplied bilingual translation. The source file names no translator. Notes that the translation file attaches to a report appear beneath it, apart from the Arabic and English text.

notes.label: Arabic text
notes.text: The Arabic is shown as supplied in the clean text of the source file, where written-out honorific formulas are replaced by Unicode symbols. The file also keeps the unaltered wording of every report.

notes.label: Flags and notes
notes.text: Source flags mark uncertainties the source records for a report, such as a lacuna, an unnamed transmitter, or a doubt over a name. They describe the text and are not judgments of authenticity. Footnotes, attached remarks, and editor material are listed apart from the report text.

notes.label: Transmitters
notes.text: Transmission paths run from the earliest named authority to the compiler, as the source lists them. The source supplies no Rijāl Register identifiers. A name links to the Rijāl Register only when it matches a single register entry; unnamed persons and the later transmitters of the copy are never linked.

notes.label: Coverage
notes.text: 321 entries in 8 sections, in the source order.

groups.title_en: From the hadith of Imam Sufyan b. Sa'id al-Thawri. Part One: the transmission of al-Sari b. Yahya from his teachers from al-Thawri. [From the hadith of Sufyan, from Abu al-Zubayr.] Al-Sari b. Yahya said:
groups.title_ar: من حديث سفيان بن سعيد الثوري القسم الأول: رواية السري بن يحيى عن شيوخه عن الثوري [من حديث سفيان عن أبي الزبير] قال السري بن يحيى:

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى، عن سفيان ، عن أبي الزبير ، عن جابر ﵁ قال:
records.matn_ar: نحرنا يوم الحديبية سبعين تسعين بدنة البدنة عن سبعة، فقال وقال رسول الله ﷺ: اشتركوا في الهدي.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
records.matn_en: We sacrificed ninety camels on the day of al-Hudaybiyya, a camel for every seven people, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Share in the offering.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن أبي الزبير ، عن جابر ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: نهى رسول الله ﷺ أن يشرب من فم السقاء.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade drinking from the mouth of the waterskin.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى، قال: حدثنا سفيان، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر ﵁، قال:
records.matn_ar: جاء أبو حميد إلى النبي ﷺ، بقدح من لبن، بالبقيع بالنقيع نهارا، فقال: ألا خمرته، ولو بعود تعرضه عليه.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
records.matn_en: Abu Humayd came to the Prophet ﷺ at al-Baqi' in the daytime with a cup of milk, and he said: “Why did you not cover it, even with a stick you lay across it?”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن أبي الزبير ، عن جابر ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: مروا على رسول الله ﷺ بحمار قد وسم في وجهه يدخن منخراه فقال لعن الله من فعل هذا ألست قد نهيت عن هذا ألا لا تسموا وجه حمار ولا تضلابوا تضربوا وجهه.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
records.matn_en: They passed by the Messenger of God ﷺ with a donkey that had been branded on its face, its nostrils smoking, and he said: “God has cursed whoever did this. Have I not forbidden this? Do not brand the face of a donkey, and do not strike its face.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن أبي الزبير ، عن جابر ﵁ قال:
records.matn_ar: قال النبي ﷺ أيما رجل كان له شرك في أرض أو ربعة فليس له أن يبيع حتى يستأذن صاحبه فإن شاء أخذ وإن شاء أذن له.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
records.matn_en: “Any man who has a share in land or a dwelling may not sell it until he asks his partner's permission: if he wishes he takes it, and if he wishes he permits [the sale].”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى وقَبِيصَة وأبو نُعَيْم قالوا حدثنا سفيان عن أبي الزبير ، عن جابر قال قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: أمسكوا عليكم أموالكم لا تعمروها أحدا فمن أعمر شيئا فهو له.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la and Qabisa and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, who all said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Keep your property for yourselves and do not give it as a life grant to anyone; whoever gives something as a life grant ('umra), it belongs to [the recipient].”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن أبي الزبير ، عن جابر قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: أمرت أن أقاتل الناس حتى يقولوا: لا إله إلا الله، فإذا قالوها عصموا مني دماءهم وأموالهم إلا بحقها، وحسابهم على الله، ثم قرأ: {فذكر إنما أنت مذكر لست عليهم بمصيطر} .
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “I have been commanded to fight people until they say: there is no god but God. When they say it, they have protected their blood and property from me except by its right, and their reckoning is with God.” Then he recited {So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder. You are not over them a controller} [al-Ghashiya 88:21-22].
flags: Text longer than the manuscript text of the same report

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم، حدثنا سفيان، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر ﵁، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ:
records.matn_ar: إن عرش إبليس على البحر، فيبعث سراياه، فأغبطهم عنده منزلة، أعظمهم فتنة.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The throne of Iblis is upon the sea, and he sends out his detachments; the one nearest to him in rank is the one who causes the greatest trial.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم، حدثنا سفيان، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر ﵁، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ:
records.matn_ar: إن إبليس قد يئس أن يعبده المصلون، ولكن في التحريش بينهم.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Iblis has despaired of being worshipped by those who pray, but [he hopes] to sow discord among them.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم، حدثنا سفيان، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر ﵁، قال:
records.matn_ar: كان النبي ﷺ يقرأ {الم تنزيل} و {تبارك} .
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to recite {Alif Lam Mim. The revelation} [Sura 32] and {Blessed is He} [Sura 67].
flags: Wording differs from the manuscript text

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن أبي الزبير ، عن جابر قال
records.matn_ar: كوى النبي ﷺ سعدا في أكحله [مرتين] .
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ cauterized Sa'd on his main arm vein [twice].

groups.title_en: From the hadith of Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Uthman b. Khuthaym
groups.title_ar: من حديث سفيان عن عبد الله بن عثمان بن خثيم

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا ابن أبو نعيم وقَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن عثمان عن شهر بن حوشب عن أم الدرداء قالت
records.matn_ar: إنما الوجل في قلب ابن آدم كاحتراق السعفة يا شهر أما يجد لها تجد القشعريرة أما تجد؟ قلت بلى، قالت: فادع فإن الدعاء عند ذاك يستجاب.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Uthman, from Shahr b. Hawshab, from Umm al-Darda', who said:
records.matn_en: Umm al-Darda' said: “Fear in the heart of the son of Adam is like the burning of a bundle of arrows. Do you not feel the shivering? Do you not feel it?” I said: “Yes.” She said: “Then supplicate, for supplication at that time is answered.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله عن عبد الرحمن بن بهمان عن عبد الرحمن بن حسان بن ثابت ، عن أبيه قال
records.matn_ar: لعن رسول الله ﷺ زوارات القبور.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Bahman, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Hassan b. Thabit, from his father, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ cursed the women who visit graves.”

narrators.en: Father of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Hassan b. Thabit

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن عثمان عن إسماعيل بن عبيد بن رفاعة الزرقي عن أبيه ، عن جده قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: إن قريشا أهل أمانة [وصدق فمن] ، بغاها العوائر أكبه الله لمنخريه من بغاها العوائر أكبه الله لمنخريه من بغاها العوائر أكبه الله لمنخريه.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Uthman [b. Khuthaym], from Isma'il b. 'Ubayd b. Rifa'a al-Zuraqi, from his father, from his grandfather, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The Quraysh are people of trust: whoever seeks to trip them up, God throws him on his nostrils” (three times).

narrators.en: Grandfather of Isma'il b. 'Ubayd b. Rifa'a al-Zuraqi
Father of Isma'il b. 'Ubayd b. Rifa'a al-Zuraqi

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن عثمان عن سعيد بن جُبَيْر ، عن ابن عباس ﵄
records.matn_ar: أن رسول الله ﷺ تزوج وهو محرم واحتجم وهو محرم.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Uthman [b. Khuthaym], from Sa'id b. Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas:
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ married while in a state of ihram, and had himself cupped while in a state of ihram.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى وقَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله ؤبن ابن عثمان عن سعيد بن جُبَيْر ، عن ابن عباس ﵄ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: خير أكحالكم الإثمد يجلو البصر وينبت الشعر.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la and Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Uthman, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The best of your kohl is antimony: it clears the sight and makes the hair grow.”

Printed text garbled in the isnad reading follows the likely intended names

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن عثمان عن إسماعيل بن عبيد بن رفاعة عن أبيه ، عن جده قال
records.matn_ar: خرج رسول الله ﷺ إلى البقيع، فقال: يا معشر التجار حتى إذا اشرأبوا قال: إن التجار يحشرون يوم القيامة فجارا إلا من اتقى وبر وصدق.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Uthman [b. Khuthaym], from Isma'il b. 'Ubayd b. Rifa'a, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ went out to al-Baqi' and said: “O company of merchants!” When they craned their necks he said: “Merchants will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection as wicked men, except for those who fear God, are righteous and are truthful.”

narrators.en: Grandfather of Isma'il b. 'Ubayd b. Rifa'a
Father of Isma'il b. 'Ubayd b. Rifa'a

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن عثمان بن خثيم عن ابن سابط عن حفصة ابنة [عبد الرحمن بن] أبي بكر على عن أم سلمة قالت
records.matn_ar: لما قدم المهاجرون المدينة تزوجوا في الأنصار فكانوا يجبونهم، وكانت الأنصار لا تفعل ذلك ، [فأراد رجل من المهاجرين امرأته على ذلك] فقالت امرأة رجل منهم منهن لزوجها: حتى أسأل رسول الله ﷺ فاستحيت أن تسأله فسألته؟ فدعا بها فقرأ عليها: {نساؤكم حرث لكم فأتوا حرثكم أنى شئتم} صمام واحد صمام واحد صمام واحد. .
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Uthman b. Khuthaym, from Ibn Sabit, from Hafsa bint 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Bakr, from Umm Salama, who said:
records.matn_en: “When the Emigrants came to Medina they married among the Ansar women and used to take them from behind, which the Ansar did not do. The wife of one of them said to her husband: 'Not until I ask the Messenger of God ﷺ.' She was too shy to ask him, so I asked him. He called her and recited to her {Your wives are a place of sowing for you, so come to your place of sowing however you wish} [al-Baqara 2:223]: one orifice (simam), one orifice, one orifice.”

narrators.en: Hafsa bint 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Bakr

records.matn_en: “Lying is not acceptable except in three cases: a man lying to his wife to please her; lying to reconcile people; and lying in war.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى بن عبيد وأبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالوا حدثنا سفيان بن سعيد الثوري عن عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل حدثنا ابن الحنفية عن علي ﵁ قال أراه قد رفعه قال
records.matn_ar: مفتاح الصلاة الطهور وتحريمها التكبير وتحليلها التسليم.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la b. 'Ubayd and Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who all said: Sufyan b. Sa'id al-Thawri narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Muhammad b. 'Aqil; Ibn al-Hanafiyya narrated to us, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: “The key to prayer is purification, its opening is the takbir, and its closing is the salam.”

records.matn_en: “We used to pray the sunset prayer with the Messenger of God ﷺ, while our houses were a mile away, then we would return to our houses and could still see where arrows fell.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن محمد بن عَقِيل عن جابر بن عبد الله ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: كنا مع رسول الله ﷺ في صير بالمدينة فقال يطلع عليكم رسول الله ﷺ مرجل رجل من أهل الجنة قال فجاء أبو بكر ﵁ فهنيناه، ثُم قال: يطلع عليكم رجل من أهل الجنة قال فجاء عمر ﵁ فهنيناه، ثُم قال: يطلع عليكم رجل من أهل الجنة قال فرأيت رسول الله ﷺ يصغي رأسه من تحت السعف ويقول اللهم إن شئت جعلته عليا فجاء علي ﵁ فهنيناه.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Muhammad b. 'Aqil, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah, who said:
records.matn_en: We were with the Messenger of God ﷺ in a palm grove (suwar) in Medina, and he said: “A man of the people of Paradise will appear before you.” Abu Bakr came and we congratulated him. Then he said: “A man of the people of Paradise will appear before you.” 'Umar came and we congratulated him. Then he said: “A man of the people of Paradise will appear before you.” He said: I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ tilting his head from beneath the palm fronds, saying: “O God, if You will, make it 'Ali.” Then 'Ali came and we congratulated him.

narrators.ar: عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، وأبرن وأبو نعيم قالا حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله عن الطفيل بن أبي بن كعب عن أبي بن كعب قال
records.matn_ar: قلت يا رسول الله ﷺ إني أكثر الصلاة عليك، فكم أجعل لك من صلاتي؟ قال: ما شئت، [قلت: الربع؟ قال: ما شئت، وإن زدت فهو خير لك، قلت النصف؟ قال: ما شئت، فإن زدت فهو خير لك، قلت الثلثين؟ قال: ما شئت] فإن زدت فهو خير لك، قلت: أجعل صلاتي كلها؟ قال: إذن تكفى همك ويغفر ذنبك.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], from al-Tufayl b. Ubayy b. Ka'b, from Ubayy b. Ka'b, who said:
records.matn_en: I said: “O Messenger of God, I invoke blessings on you often; how much of my prayer should I devote to you?” He said: “As you wish.” I said: “A quarter?” He said: “As you wish, and if you add, it is better for you.” I said: “A third?” He said: “As you wish, and if you add, it is better for you.” I said: “Half?” He said: “As you wish, and if you add, it is better for you.” I said: “Two thirds?” He said: “As you wish, and if you add, it is better for you.” I said: “Shall I make all my prayer for you?” He said: “Then your worry will be taken care of and your sin forgiven.”

records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ إذا ضحى اشترى كبشين عظيمين، سمينين أقرنين، أملحين موجؤين يذبح أحدهما عن أمته من شهد منهم بالتوحيد، وشهد له بالبلاغ، ويذبح الآخر عن محمد ﷺ، وآل محمد ﷺ.

records.matn_en: When the Messenger of God ﷺ wished to offer a sacrifice, he would buy two large, fat, horned, white-and-black, castrated rams; he would slaughter one for his community, those who bore witness to the oneness [of God] and to his delivery of the message, and slaughter the other for Muhammad and the family of Muhammad ﷺ.

records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ: إذا جاء ربع الليل قام فقال أيها الناس اذكروا الله اذكروا الله جاءت الراجفة تتبعها الرادفة تتبعها الرادفة، جاء الموت بما فيه جاء الموت بما فيه. سفيان بن سعيد عن أبي إسحاق .

records.matn_en: When a quarter of the night had passed, the Messenger of God ﷺ would rise and say: “O people, remember God! The first blast has come, followed by the second; death has come with what it brings; death has come with what it brings.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن أبي عبيدة عن عبد الله قال
records.matn_ar: لا تقبل صلاة بغير طهور ولا صدقة من غلول.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu 'Ubayda, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], who said:
records.matn_en: “No prayer is accepted without purification, and no charity from stolen goods.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن أبي حبة بن قيس عن علي ﵁
records.matn_ar: أنه بدأ فغسل يديه ثلاثا ثم تمضمض واستنشق ثلاثا ثم غسل وجهه ثلاثا، ثم غسل قدميه ثلاثا ثم مسح برأسه ثلاثا ثم غسل يديه ثلاثا، ثم قام قائما فشرب فضل الإناء ، ثم قال: هكذا رأيت رسول الله ﷺ يتوضأ.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Hayya b. Qays, from 'Ali:
records.matn_en: that he performed ablution: he washed his hands three times, rinsed his mouth and snuffed water three times, washed his face three times, washed his feet three times, wiped his head three times, then washed [his limbs] three times each; then he stood and drank the remainder of the water in the vessel and said: “Thus I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ do on a day.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن ؤعاصم بن عمرو قال
records.matn_ar: جاء نفر إلى عمر ﵁ فسألوه عن الحائض ما لزوجها منها وعن الغسل من الجنابرة الجنابة وعن صلاة الرجل تطوعا في بيته فقال أسحار أنتم سألت رسول الله ﷺ عن الحائض ما لزوجها منها قال ما وراء الإزار وعن الغسل من الجنابة فقال يتوضأ وضوئه وضوءه للصلاة ثم يفرغه على رأسه ثلاثا ثم يفرغ على جسده وعن صلاة الرجل في بيته قال نور فنور بيتك.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Asim b. 'Amr, who said:
records.matn_en: A group came to 'Umar and asked him about what is permitted to a husband of his menstruating wife, about the ritual bath after sexual impurity, and about a man's voluntary prayer for God's sake in his house. He said: “Are you sorcerers? I have not been asked about these since I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ. I asked about what is permitted to a husband of his menstruating wife, and he said: 'What is below the waist-wrapper.' And about the bath after sexual impurity, and he said: 'He performs his ablution as for prayer, then pours water over his head three times, then over his body.' And about a man's voluntary prayer for God's sake in his house, and he said: 'Light upon light for your house.'”

records.matn_ar: في مس الذكر قال لا بأس به ما لم يعمد ذلك.

records.isnad_ar: عن وكيع عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن يحيى بن وثاب عن ابن عمر عن النبي ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: من جاء إلى الجمعة فليغتسل.
records.isnad_en: From Waki', from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Yahya b. Wathab, from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever of you comes to the Friday prayer, let him perform the full bath.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن عاصم بن ضمرة عن علي ﵁ قال:
records.matn_ar: كان يدعو فيقول: تم نورك فهديت فلك الحمد، وعظم حلمك فعفوت فلك الحمد، وبسطت يدك فأعطيت فلك الحمد ربنا وجهك أكرم الوجوه، وجاهك خير الجاه، وعطيتك أفضل العطية وأهنؤها، تطاع ربنا فتشكر، وتعصى ربنا فتغفر لمن شئت، تجيب المضطر، وتكشف الضر، وتشفي السقيم، وتنجي من الكرب وتقبل التوبة، وتغفر الذنوب، لا يجزئ بآلائك أحد تجزى بآلائك، ولا يحصي نعماءك قول قائل.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Asim b. Damra, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: He used to supplicate, saying: “Your light is complete, so You guided: to You is the praise. Your forbearance is great, so You pardoned: to You is the praise. You extended Your hand and gave: to You is the praise. Our Lord, Your Face is the most noble of faces, Your standing the best of standings, and Your gift the best and most pleasant of gifts. You are obeyed, our Lord, and thanked; You are disobeyed, our Lord, and You forgive whom You will. You answer the distressed, remove harm, heal the sick, deliver from distress, accept repentance and forgive sins. No speaker can repay Your favors, and none can count Your blessings.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا وكيع عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن عبد الله بن أبي بصير عن أبي بن كعب قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: إن الصف الأول على مثل صف الملائكة ولو تعلمون فضيلته لابتدرتموه.
records.isnad_en: Waki' narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Basir, from Ubayy b. Ka'b, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The first row is like the row of the angels; if you knew its merit, you would race to it.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن التميمي واسمه [أربدة] عن ابن عباس ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ إذا سجد رؤي بياض إبطيه.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Tamimi [sic, for al-Taymi], whose name was Arbada, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
records.matn_en: “When the Messenger of God ﷺ prostrated, the whiteness of his armpits could be seen.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبرن أبو نعيم عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن عبد الله بن يزيد قال: حدثني البراء وكان غير كذوب قال
records.matn_ar: كنا إذا صلينا خلف النبي ﷺ لم يحن أحد منا ظهره حتى يضع النبي ﷺ جبهته.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Abd Allah b. Yazid, who said: Al-Bara', who was not a liar, narrated to me, saying:
records.matn_en: “When we prayed behind the Prophet ﷺ, none of us would bend his back until the Prophet ﷺ had placed his forehead [on the ground].”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن منصور والأعمش ، وحماد وحصين عن أبي وائل عن عبد الله ﵁ وعن أبي إسحاق عن أبي عبيدة والأسود وأبي الأحوص عن عبد الله عن النبي ﷺ
records.matn_ar: أنه كان يعلمهم التشهد التحيات لله والصلوات والطيبات السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله.

records.matn_en: that he used to teach them the tashahhud: “Greetings to God, and prayers and good things. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of God and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of God. I bear witness that there is no god but God, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن أبي الأحوص عن عبد الله ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: صلاة الرجل في جماعة تزيد على صلاة الرجل وحده بضع وعشرون درجة.

records.matn_en: “A man's prayer in congregation exceeds his prayer alone by twenty-odd degrees.”

records.matn_ar: إذا قفل من سفر قال آيبون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Bara', that the Prophet ﷺ
records.matn_en: when he returned from a journey, would say: “Returning, repenting, worshipping, praising our Lord.”

records.matn_en: “It is enough sin for a man that he neglect those he must support.”

records.matn_en: When the Prophet ﷺ wished to sleep and lay down, he would place his cheek on his right hand and say: “My Lord, protect me from Your punishment on the day You raise Your servants.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق قال: أخبرني جري النهدي قال بعثني رجل من بني سليم بالكناسة فقال عبد الله بن مسعود ﵁ ،
records.matn_ar: عد رسول الله ﷺ في يدي أو في يده خمسا التسبيح نصف الميزان التسبيح نصف الميزان ، والحمد لله يملؤه ، والتكبير يملأ ما بين السماوات السماء والأرض ، والصوم نصف الصبر ، والطهور نصف الإيمان.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq; Jariyy al-Nahdi informed me, who said:
records.matn_en: [A man of Banu Sulaym said to me:] “The Messenger of God ﷺ counted five on my hand, or on his hand: 'Tasbih is half the scale; 'praise be to God' fills it; takbir fills what is between the heaven and the earth; fasting is half of patience; and purification is half of faith.'”

records.matn_ar: كان من دعاء النبي ﷺ اللهم إني أسألك الهدى والتقى والعفة والغنى.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], who said:
records.matn_en: Among the supplications of the Prophet ﷺ was: “O God, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن هبيرة بن يريم عن علي ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ يوقظ أهله في العشر الأواخر ويشمر.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Hubayra b. Yarim, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ would wake his family in the last ten nights [of Ramadan] and gird himself [for worship].”

records.matn_ar: الآن نغزوهم ولا يغزونا.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Sulayman b. Surad, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said on the day of al-Ahzab: “Now we will raid them and they will not raid us.”

records.matn_ar: لا تسبوا الأموات فتؤذوا الأحياء.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم قال: حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن ناجية بن كعب عن علي ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: أتيت النبي ﷺ فقلت إن عمك الضال قد مات يعني أباه قد مات قال انطلق فواره ولا تحدثن شيئا حتى تأتيني فأتيته فأمرني فاغتسلت ودعا لي بدعوات ما يسرني بهن ما عرض من شيء.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Najiya b. Ka'b, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: I came to the Prophet ﷺ [and said]: “Your misguided uncle,” meaning his father, “has died.” He said: “Go and bury him, and do nothing new until you come back to me.” I came to him and he ordered me, so I bathed, and he supplicated for me with supplications that please me whatever befalls.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن مسلم بن نذرير السعدي عن حذيفة ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: أخذ رسول الله ﷺ بعضلة ساقي أو ساقه فقال هذا موضع الإزار فإن أبيت فأسفل من ذلك فإن أبيت فأسفل من ذلك فإن أبيت فلا حق للإزار في بالكعبين.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Muslim b. Nudhayr al-Sa'di, from Hudhayfa, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ took hold of the muscle of my calf, or of his own calf, and said: “This is the place of the waist-wrapper; if you refuse, then lower; if you refuse, then lower; and if you refuse, the waist-wrapper has no right over the ankles.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن أبي الأحوص عن عبد الله ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ يسلم عن يمينه وعن يساره السلام عليكم ورحمة الله حتى يرى بياض خده.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to give the salam to his right and to his left: “Peace be upon you and the mercy of God,” until the whiteness of his cheek could be seen.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن الحارث عن علي ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: انصرف حيث كان صاحبك.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: “Turn away [from the prayer] wherever your need lies.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن حارثة بن وهب الخزاعي قال
records.matn_ar: صلينا مع رسول الله ﷺ بمنى أكثر ما كان الناس وآمنه ركعتين في حجة الوداع.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Haritha b. Wahb al-Khuza'i, who said:
records.matn_en: We prayed with the Messenger of God ﷺ at Mina, when the people were most numerous and most secure, two rak'as in the Farewell Pilgrimage.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد عن عبد الله
records.matn_ar: أنه كره أنَّ أن يبزق عن يمينه في غير الصلاة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud]:
records.matn_en: that he disliked spitting to his right outside the prayer.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن عاصم بن ضمرة عن علي ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ يصلي على أثر كل صلاة ركعتين إلا في الفجر والعصر.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Asim b. Damra, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ used to pray two rak'as after every prayer, except the dawn and the afternoon prayers.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: عن وكيع عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن عاصم بن ضمرة عن علي ﵁
records.matn_ar: أن النبي ﷺ كان يصلي أربعا قبل الظهر.
records.isnad_en: From Waki', from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Asim b. Damra, from 'Ali:
records.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray four rak'as before the noon prayer.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن عاصم بن ضمرة عن علي ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: ليس الوتر بحتم كهيئة المكتوبة ولكنها سنة سنها رسول الله ﷺ.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Asim b. Damra, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: “The witr prayer is not a seal for this obligatory prayer; rather it is a sunna that the Messenger of God ﷺ instituted.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا وكيع عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن عاصم بن ضمرة قال
records.matn_ar: سألنا عليا عن تطوع رسول الله ﷺ بالنهار فقال إنكم لا تطيقونه فقلنا أخبرنا به نأخذ منه ما أطقنا فقال كان رسول الله ﷺ إذا صلى الفجر أمهل ، حتى إذا كانت الشمس من هاهنا من قبل المشرق مقدارها من صلاة العصر من هاهنا يعني من قبل المغرب قام فصلى ركعتين ثم أمهل حتى إذا كانت الشمس من هاهنا يعني من قبل المشرق مقدارها من صلاة الظهر من هاهنا يعني من قبل المغرب قام فصلى أربعا وأربعا قبل الظهر إذا زالت الشمس وركعتين بعد الظهر وأربعا قبل العصر يفصل بين كل ركعيتن بالتسليم على الملائكة المقربين والنبيين ومن تبعهم من المء=ؤمنينالمؤمنين والمسلمين. قال علي: فست عشرة ركعة تطوع رسول الله بالنهار وقل من يداوم عليها.
records.isnad_en: Waki' narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Asim b. Damra, who said:
records.matn_en: We asked 'Ali about the voluntary prayers of the Messenger of God ﷺ by day, and he said: “You cannot bear it.” We said: “Tell us, and we will take what we can bear.” He said: “When the Messenger of God ﷺ prayed the dawn prayer he waited until the sun was in the east at the height it has for the afternoon prayer in the west, then rose and prayed two rak'as. Then he waited until the sun was in the east at the height it has for the noon prayer in the west, and rose and prayed four, and four before the noon prayer when the sun had passed the zenith, and two after the noon prayer, and four before the afternoon prayer, separating every two rak'as with the salam upon the angels brought near, the prophets, and those who followed them among the believers and Muslims.” 'Ali said: “That is sixteen rak'as of the voluntary prayer of the Messenger of God by day, and few keep to it.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن نمير بن عريب عن عامر بن مسعود قال:
records.matn_ar: قال رسول الله ﷺ الصوم في الشتاء الغنيمة الباردة.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Numayr b. 'Arib, from 'Amir b. Mas'ud, who said:
records.matn_en: “Fasting in winter is the cold spoils.”

records.matn_ar: صلى النبي ﷺ الصلاتين بجمع بإقامة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Abd Allah b. Malik, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:

records.matn_ar: كفى بالمرء إثما أن يضيع من يقوت.

records.matn_ar: كان المشركون لا يفيضون من جمع حتى يرون الشمس على ثبير فخالفهم النبي ﷺ فأفاض قبل أن تطلع الشمس.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى وأبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالوا حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن النجراني قال
records.matn_ar: أتي رسول الله ﷺ برجل سكران فقال أي شيء شربت قال نبيذ قال تمر وزبيب قال لا تخلطوهما كل واحد منهما يكفي وحده ثم ضربه.

records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ was brought a drunken man and said: “What did you drink?” He said: “Nabidh.” He said: “[Of] dates and raisins?” He said: “Do not mix them; each of them suffices by itself.” Then he flogged him.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن أبي عبيدة عن عبد الله قال
records.matn_ar: أشد الناس عذابا يوم القيامة إمام جائر يضل الناس بغير علم ورجل قتل نبيا أو قتله نبي ومصور.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu 'Ubayda, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], who said:
records.matn_en: “The people most severely punished on the Day of Resurrection are a misleading leader who misleads people without knowledge; a man who killed a prophet or was killed by one; and a maker of these images.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن عمرو بن غالب قال
records.matn_ar: دخل الأشتر على عائشة ﵂ فقالت أنت الذي حرضت عليا قتل ابن أختي قال قد حرصت على قتله وحرص على قتلي قالت أما سمعت ما قال رسول الله ﷺ لا يحل دم امرىء مسلم إلا في ثلاثة النفس بالنفس والثيب الزاني والتارك للإسلام.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Amr b. Ghalib, who said:
records.matn_en: Al-Ashtar came in to 'A'isha, and she said: “Are you the one who incited 'Ali to kill my sister's son?” He said: “I was eager to kill him, and he was eager to kill me.” She said: “Have you not heard what the Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'The blood of a Muslim is not lawful except in three cases: a life for a life, the married adulterer, and one who abandons Islam.'”

records.matn_ar: اشتكى رجل من الأنصار فاشتد وجعه فنعت له الكي ، وأتوا رسول الله ﷺ فسألوه فسكت فسألوه ثم فسكت ثم سألوه فسكت ثم سألوه فسكت فسألوه فقال: إن شئتم فاكووه، وإن شئتم فارضفوه بالرضف.

They asked again, and he was silent; they asked again, and he was silent; then they asked again and he said: “If you wish, cauterize him, and if you wish, heat stones and apply them.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى وأبو نُعَيْم قالا حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن هبيرة بن يريم عن عبد الله ﵁ قال محمد بن نأتى
records.matn_ar: من أتى كاهنا أو سادنا أو عرافا فصدقه بما يقول فقد كفر بما أنزل على محمد النبي ﷺ.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Hubayra b. Yarim, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever goes to a soothsayer, sorcerer or diviner and believes what he says has disbelieved in what was revealed to Muhammad, the Prophet ﷺ.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن عبد الله بن حلام عن عبد الله بن مسعود ﵁ ، قال
records.matn_ar: رأى رسول الله ﷺ امرأة فأعجبته، فأتى سودة وهي تصنع طيبا وعندها نساء، فأخلينه، فقضى حاجته ثم مضى، ثم قال: أيما رجل رأى امرأة تعجبه فليقم إلى أهله، فإن معها مثل الذي معها.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Abd Allah b. Hilam, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ saw a woman and she pleased him. He went to Sawda, who was applying perfume, with women with her; they cleared the way for him, and he fulfilled his need, then left and said: “Any man who sees a woman who pleases him, let him go to his wife, for she has the same as that woman has.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن هبيرة بن يريم عن علي ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ يوقظ أهله في العشر الأواخر ويشمر.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Hubayra b. Yarim, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ would wake his family in the last ten nights and gird himself.”
flags: Repeats the wording of report 49 with a different chain
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن خمير بن مالك قال: قال عبد الله
records.matn_ar: لقد قرأت من في رسول الله ﷺ سبعين سورة وزيد بن ثابت ﵁ له [ذؤابتان] يلعب مع الصبيان.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Khumayr b. Malik, who said:
records.matn_en: 'Abd Allah said: “I recited seventy suras from the mouth of the Messenger of God ﷺ, while Zayd b. Thabit had two locks of hair and was playing with the boys.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic
Contains editorial bracketed insertions

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن أبي حبيبة الطائي قال
records.matn_ar: أتيت أبا الدرداء ﵁ فقلت إن أخا لي مات ، وأوصى لي بطائفة من ماله ، فأين أضعه؟ في الفقراء في المجاهدين في الرقاب؟ فقال: أما أنا فلو كنت لم أعدل بالمجاهدين ، إن رسول الله ﷺ قال: مثل الذي يعتق عند الموت مثل الذي يهدي بعد ماعندما يشبع.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Habiba al-Ta'i, who said:
records.matn_en: I came to Abu al-Darda' and said: “My brother died and bequeathed to me a portion of his property; where shall I put it: among the poor, the fighters, or in freeing slaves?” He said: “As for me, if it were mine I would not prefer anything to the fighters. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “The one who frees [slaves] at the time of death is like the one who gives a gift when he is full.”'”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن البراء ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ إذا قفل من سفر قال آيبون تائبون لربينا حامدون.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Bara', who said:
records.matn_en: When the Messenger of God ﷺ returned from a journey he would say: “Returning, repenting, praising our Lord.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا وكيع عن سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن سعيد بن ذي حدان عمن سمع عليا يقول
records.matn_ar: إنَّ الله عز وجل سمى الحرب على لسان نبيه خدعة.
records.isnad_en: Waki' narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Sa'id b. Dhi Hiddan, from one who heard 'Ali say:
records.matn_en: “God named war, by the tongue of His Prophet, deceit.”
flags: Unnamed transmitter in chain
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن أبي إسحاق عن أصحابه عن علي ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: ما أرى أحد أدركه عقله وبايعه الإسلام ينام حتى يقرأ خواتيم سورة البقرة فإنهن من كنز تحت العرش. سفيان بن سعيد عن منصور .
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from his companions, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: “I do not think anyone who has reason and whom Islam has reached would sleep before reciting the closing verses of Sura al-Baqara, for they are from a treasure beneath the Throne.”
flags: Unnamed transmitters in chain
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قال حدثنا سفيان عن منصور وحصين عن أبي وائل عن حذيفة ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ إذا قام من الليل يشوص فاه بالسواك.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur and Husayn, from Abu Wa'il, from Hudhayfa, who said:
records.matn_en: “When the Messenger of God ﷺ rose in the night, he would scour his mouth with the toothstick.”

extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (practice reported by Hudhayfa) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن منصور عن إبراهيم قال
records.matn_ar: كان يقال بلوا الشعر وأنقوا البشرة.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said:
records.matn_en: It used to be said: “Wet the hair and cleanse the skin.”

records.isnad_ar: عن وكيع عن سفيان عن منصور عن هلال بن يساف عن أبي يحيى عن عبد الله بن عمرو ﵄ قال قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: أسبغوا الوضوء.
records.isnad_en: From Waki', from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Hilal b. Yisaf, from Abu Yahya, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Perform the ablution fully.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، وأبو نُعَيْم قالا حدثنا سفيان عن منصور عن سالم بن أبي الجعد عن علي ﵁
records.matn_ar: في الجنب إذا أراد أن ينام يتوضأ وضوئه وضوءه للصلاة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from 'Ali
records.matn_en: concerning the person in a state of sexual impurity who wants to sleep: he performs the ablution for prayer.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن منصور عن إبراهيم
records.matn_ar: مثل حديث عائشة ﵂: كان رسول الله ﷺ يتوضا يتوضأ وضوئه وضوءه للصلاة يعني وهو جنب.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim:
records.matn_en: [the same] as the hadith of 'A'isha: she said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ would perform his ablution for prayer” (meaning while in a state of sexual impurity).

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن منصور عن إبراهيم عن الأسود عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: كنت أغتسل أنا ورسول الله ﷺ من إناء واحد وأنا جنب وكان يأمرني أتزر قيباشرني فيباشرني وأنا حائض وكان يخرج رأسه من المسجد وهو معتكف وأغسله وأنا حائض.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: 'A'isha said: “I would bathe with the Messenger of God ﷺ from a single vessel while I was in a state of sexual impurity; and he would order me and I would put on a waist-wrapper and he would be intimate with me while I was menstruating; and he would put his head out to me from the mosque while in spiritual retreat and I would wash it while I was menstruating.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور والأعمش ، عن أبي وائل عن حذيفة ﵁
records.matn_ar: أن النبي ﷺ أتى سباطة قوم فبال قائما.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur and al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, from Hudhayfa:
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ came to the rubbish heap of some people and urinated standing.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن هلال بن يساف عن أبي يحيى عن عبد الله بن عمرو ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: رأى رسول الله ﷺ قوما تلوح أعقابهم فقال ويل للأعقاب من النار أسبغوا الوضوء.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Hilal b. Yisaf, from Abu Yahya, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ saw people whose heels were glistening [with unwashed spots], and said: “Woe to the heels from the Fire! Perform the ablution fully.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ويعلى عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن مجاهد عن الحكم بن سفيان أو سفيان بن الحكم الثقفي عن النبي ﷺ
records.matn_ar: أنه توضأ فنضح فرجه قال فرأيت البلل من وراء الثوب.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa and Ya'la narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from al-Hakam b. Sufyan or Sufyan b. al-Hakam al-Thaqafi, from the Prophet ﷺ:
records.matn_en: that he performed ablution and sprinkled his private part, and he said: “I saw the wetness from behind the garment.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور والأعمش ، عن أبي وائل عن حذيفة ﵁
records.matn_ar: أن النبي ﷺ أتى سباطة قوم فبال قائما. قال سفيان زاد الأعمش: ثم دعا فأتي بماء فتوضأ ومسح على خفيه.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur and al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, from Hudhayfa:
records.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ came to the rubbish heap of some people and urinated standing. Sufyan said: Al-A'mash added: “Then he stepped aside, was brought water, performed ablution and wiped over his leather socks.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن خيثمة عن أبي عبيدة قال
records.matn_ar: سافر عبد الله إلى المدينة فلم ينزع خفيه ثلاثة أيام.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Khaythama, from Abu 'Ubayda, who said:
records.matn_en: 'Abd Allah traveled to Medina and did not take off his leather socks for three days.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور والأعمش ، عن إبراهيم عن الأسود قال
records.matn_ar: كان آخر أذان بلال اللهُ أَكْبَر اللهُ أَكْبَر لا إله إلا الله.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur and al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, who said:
records.matn_en: The last of Bilal's call to prayer was: “God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن هلال بن يساف عن وهب بن الأجدع عن علي ﵁ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: لا تصلوا بعد العصر إلا أن تصلوا والشمس مرتفعة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Hilal b. Yisaf, from Wahb b. al-Ajda', from 'Ali, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Do not pray after the afternoon prayer, unless you pray while the sun is still high.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم قال
records.matn_ar: كانوا ربما عجلوا العصر إذا كانت جنازة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said:
records.matn_en: They would sometimes hasten the afternoon prayer when there was a funeral.

records.matn_en: “There is no evening conversation after the prayer except for one who prays or one who travels.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور والأعمش ، عن طلحة بن مصرف عن عبد الرحمن بن عوسجة عن البراء بن عازب ﵁ عن النبي ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: إن لله ملائكة يصلون على الصفوف الأول.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur and al-A'mash, from Talha b. Musarrif, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awsaja, from al-Bara' b. 'Azib, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “God and His angels send blessings on the first rows.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن مجاهد عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: كره أن يجهر بالقراءة بالنهار في الصلاة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: He disliked reciting aloud in the daytime prayer.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن أبي الضحى عن مسروق عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: كان النبي ﷺ يكثر أن يقول في ركوعه وسجوده سبحانك اللهم ربنا وبحمدك اللهم اغفر لي يتأولون القرآن {فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره إنه كان توابا} .
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ often used to say in his bowing and prostration: “Glory to You, O God, our Lord, and praise; O God, forgive me”, interpreting the Qur'an {So exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance} [al-Nasr 110:3].
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة وأبو نُعَيْم قالا حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن عدي عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: من سمع النداء فلم يجبه لم يرد خيرا ولم يراد به خيرا.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from 'Adi, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever hears the call and does not answer it did not want good, and good was not wanted for him.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن مجاهد عن أبي عياش الزرقي قال
records.matn_ar: صلى رسول الله ﷺ الظهر بعسفان والمشركون بينه وبين القبلة ، معهم، أو عليهم ، خالد بن الوليد ، فقال المشركون: كانوا في صلاة لو أصبنا منهم كانت هي الغنيمة، فقال المشركون: إنها ستجيء صلاة هي أحب إليهم من أموالهم وآبائهم وأبنائهم قال: فنزل جبريل ﵇ بالآيات فيما بين الظهر والعصر ، فصلى رسول الله ﷺ، وصف الناس خلفه صفين ، [وكبر وكبروا] معه ، ثم ركع وركعوا جميعا ثم رفع ورفعوا جميعا ، ثم سجد وسجد معه الصف الذي يلونه ، وقام الصف المؤخر يحرسونهم بسلاحهم ، ثم رفع ورفعوا ، ثم سجد الصف المؤخر ورفعوا فتأخر الصف المقدم وتقدم الصف المؤخر ، فكبر وكبروا معه ، ثم ركع وركعوا معه جميعا ، ثم رفع ورفعوا جميعا ، ثم سجد وسجدوا الصف الذي يلونه وقام الصف المؤخر يحرسونهم بسلاحهم يحرسونهم، ثم رفع ورفعوا ، ثم سجد الصف المؤخر ثم سلم عليهم وصلاها من آخرىن في أرض بني سليم.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Abu 'Ayyash al-Zuraqi, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ prayed the noon prayer at 'Usfan, with the polytheists between him and the qibla, and with them, or over them, was Khalid b. al-Walid. The polytheists said: 'They were in a prayer; had we attacked them it would have been the spoils.' Then the polytheists said: 'A prayer is coming that is dearer to them than their fathers and sons.' Jibril came down with the verses between the noon and afternoon prayers, and the Messenger of God ﷺ prayed with the people lined up in two rows behind him. He said takbir and they said takbir with him; he bowed and they bowed; he rose and they rose together; then he prostrated, and the row nearest him prostrated with him, while the rear row stood guarding them with their weapons. Then he rose and they rose; the rear row prostrated, then the front row stepped back and the rear row came forward. He said takbir and they said takbir with him, then he bowed and they all bowed with him, he rose and they all rose, then he prostrated and the row nearest him prostrated, while the rear row stood guarding them with their weapons; then he rose and they rose; then the rear row prostrated; then he gave the salam to them. And he prayed it once more in the land of Banu Sulaym.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان [عن مَنْصُور] عن هلال بن يساف عن سعيد بن زيد
records.matn_ar: أن النبي ﷺ قال: اثبت حراء ، فإنه ليس فما عليك إلا نبي أو صديق أو شهيد وعليه النبي ﷺ وأبو بكر ، وعمر ، وعثمان ، وعلي ، وطلحة ، والزبير ، وعبد الرحمن بن عوف ، وسعد بن مالك، رضوان الله عليهم.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Hilal b. Yisaf, from Sa'id b. Zayd:
records.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ was on Hira' and it moved, and he said: “Be still, Hira': there is upon you only a prophet, a truthful one, or a martyr.” And on it were the Prophet, Abu Bakr, 'Umar, 'Uthman, 'Ali, Talha, al-Zubayr, 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf and Sa'd b. Malik, may God be pleased with them.

Contains editorial bracketed insertions

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن أبي وائل عن أبي موسى ﵁ عن النبي ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: أطعموا الجائع وعودوا المريض وفكوا العاني.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Abu Wa'il, from Abu Musa, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and free the captive in debt.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن الحكم عن عبد الرحمن ابن أبي ليلى عن كعب بن عجرة ﵁ عن النبي ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: معقبات لا يخيب قائلهن أو فاعلهن: تسبح الله ثلاثا وثلاثين، وتحمده ثلاثا وثلاثين، وتكيبر أربعا وثلاثين في دبر كل صلاة مكتوبة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from al-Hakam, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, from Ka'b b. 'Ujra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Those that follow [the prayer] never disappoint whoever says or does them: glorify God thirty-three times, praise Him thirty-three times, and magnify Him thirty-four times, after every obligatory prayer.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم قال
records.matn_ar: ليس شيء من الكلام يضاعف الحمد الحمد أكثر الكلام تضعيفا.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said:
records.matn_en: Ibrahim said: “No word is multiplied like praise; praise is the speech that is multiplied most.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن مجاهد {والباقيات الصالحات} قال
records.matn_ar: سبحان الله والحمد لله ولا إله إلا الله واللهُ أَكْبَر.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid, concerning {and the enduring good deeds} [al-Kahf 18:46]; he said:
records.matn_en: He said: “Glory be to God, praise be to God, there is no god but God, and God is greatest.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن هلال بن يساف عن الأغر ، عن أبي هريرة ﵁ ، قال
records.matn_ar: من قال لا إله إلا الله أنجته يوما من دهره أصابه قبل ذلك ما أصابه.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Hilal b. Yisaf, from al-Aghar, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever says 'There is no god but God,' it will save him one day of his life, whatever befell him before that.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن فضيل بن عمرو عن زياد بن الحصين عن أبي العالية قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ بأخرة إذا قام من مجلسه قال سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك أشهد أن لا إله إلا أنت أستغفرك وأتوب إليك فقيل يا رسول الله كلمات تقولهن بآخرة بأخرة قال كلمات علمنيهن جبريل كفارات لما يكون في المجلس.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Fudayl b. 'Amr, from Ziyad b. al-Husayn, from Abu al-'Aliya, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ, at the end [of his life], when he rose from his gathering, would say: “Glory be to You, O God, and with Your praise; I bear witness that there is no god but You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.” It was said: “O Messenger of God, these are words you say at the end.” He said: “Words Jibril taught me, expiations for whatever occurs in the gathering.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم قال
records.matn_ar: كان يعلمونهن عند المنام التسبيح والتكبير والتحميد ويقرأون ويقرؤون المعوذتين.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said:
records.matn_en: They used to teach them [the children] at bedtime: tasbih, takbir and tahmid, and they would recite the two protective suras [al-Falaq and al-Nas].

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن هلال بن يساف عن أبي عبيدة قال
records.matn_ar: ما دام قلب رجل يذكر الله فهو في صلاة وإن يحرك به شفتيه أفضل.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Hilal b. Yisaf, from Abu 'Ubayda, who said:
records.matn_en: “As long as a man's heart remembers God he is in prayer, and moving his lips with it is better.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة وأبو نُعَيْم جميعا قالا حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن ذر عن يسيع عن النعمان بن بشير ﵁ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: إن الدعاء هو العبادة ثم قرأ {وقال ربكم ادعوني أستجب لكم إن الذين يستكبرون عن عبادتي سيدخلون جهنم داخرين} .
records.isnad_en: Qabisa and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, both together, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Dharr, from Yusay', from al-Nu'man b. Bashir, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Supplication is worship.” Then he recited {And your Lord says, 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you.' Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell humbled} [Ghafir 40:60].
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن هلال بن يساف عن رجل من ثقيف عن رجل من جهينة عن النبي ﷺ قال
records.matn_ar: إنكم لعلكم تقاتلون قوما فتظهرون عليهم فيتقونكم بأموالهم دون أنفسهم وأبنائهم ويصالحونكم على صلح فلا تصيبوا تصيبون منهم فوق ذلك فإنه لا يحل لكم.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Hilal b. Yisaf, from a man of Thaqif, from a man of Juhayna, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Perhaps you will fight a people and prevail over them, and they will offer you their property instead of themselves and their children, and make peace with you on terms; then take from them nothing beyond that, for it is not lawful for you.”
flags: Unnamed transmitters in chain
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن ربعي بن حراش قال كنا
records.matn_ar: كنت في جنازة حُذَيفة، فسمعت رجلا يقول: سمعت هذا يقول: ما بي بأس مما سمعت عن رسول الله ﷺ: لئن اقتتلتم لأنظرن إلى أقصى بيت في داري، فلأدخلنَّه، فلئن دخل عَليّ لأقولن: بؤ بإثمي وإثمك، فأكون كابني آدم.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Rib'i b. Hirash, who said:
records.matn_en: I was at the funeral of Hudhayfa and heard a man say: “I heard this man say: 'There is no harm in what I heard from the Messenger of God ﷺ: “If you fight one another, I will look to the farthest room in my house and go into it; and if someone enters upon me, I will say: Bear my sin and yours, and be like the two sons of Adam.”'”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن ربعي بن حراش عن البراء بن ناجية المحاربي عن عبد الله قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: تدور رحى الإسلام على خمس ة ثلاثين أو ست وثلاثين فإن هلكوا فسبيل من هلك وإن يبقى لهم دينهم فسبعين عاما قال عمر ﵁ يا رسول الله مما مضى أو مما بقي قال مما بقي.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Rib'i b. Hirash, from al-Bara' b. Najiya al-Muharibi, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The mill of Islam will turn for thirty-five or thirty-six; if they perish, then it is the path of those who perish, and if their religion remains for them, then seventy years.” 'Umar said: “O Messenger of God, from what has passed or what remains?” He said: “From what remains.”

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم عن علقمة قال
records.matn_ar: جاء ابنا مليكة الجعفيان إلى رسول الله ﷺ فقالا يا رسول الله إن أمنا وأدت في الجاهلية فهل ينفعها صلاة مع صلاتنا أو صيام مع صيامنا فقال رسول الله ﷺ الوائدة والموؤدة في النار فوليا وهما يبكيان فدعاهما فقال وأمي مع أمكما.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from 'Alqama, who said:
records.matn_en: The two sons of Mulayka al-Ju'fiyani came to the Messenger of God ﷺ and said: “Our mother buried a daughter alive in the Jahiliyya; will a prayer with our prayer, or a fast with our fast, benefit her?” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “The one who buries and the one buried are in the Fire.” They turned away weeping, and he called them back and said: “And my mother is with your mother.”
flags: Mursal report by successor
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن ربعي بن حراش عن امرأته عن أخت حذيفة ﵁ قالت
records.matn_ar: خطبنا رسول الله ﷺ فقال يا معشر النساء إن لكن في الفضة ما تحلين ما من امرأة تحلى بذهب تظهره إلا عذبت به يوم القيامة. قال منصور فذكرت ذلك لمجاهد فقال أدركت النساء وإن المرأة لتستر الزر في كم القميص توار به الخاتم.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Rib'i b. Hirash, from his wife, from the sister of Hudhayfa, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ addressed us and said: “O company of women, in silver you have enough to adorn yourselves; there is no woman who adorns herself with gold and shows it but she will be punished with it on the Day of Resurrection.” Mansur said: I mentioned that to Mujahid and he said: “I knew women who would fasten a button in the sleeve of the shirt to hide the ring.”

records.matn_ar: لعن الله الواشمات و [المستوشمات] والمتنمصات والمتفلجات للحسن [المغيرات خلق الله] .. ، وذكر الحديث.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from 'Alqama, who said:
records.matn_en: 'Abd Allah said: “God has cursed women who tattoo and who have themselves tattooed, who pluck their eyebrows, and who file their teeth for beauty.” And he mentioned the rest of the hadith.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا وكيع عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن مجاهد عن يوسف عن عبد الله بن الزبير قال
records.matn_ar: جاء رجل إلى النبي ﷺ فقال يا رسول الله إن أبي مات ولم يحج أفحج عنه قال أنت أكبر ولده قال نعم قال فحج عن أبيك أفرأيت لو كان على أبيك دين فقضيته.
records.isnad_en: Waki' narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Yusuf, from 'Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr, who said:
records.matn_en: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of God, my father died without performing the pilgrimage; shall I perform it on his behalf?” He said: “Are you his eldest child?” He said: “Yes.” He said: “Then perform the pilgrimage for your father. Do you not see that if your father had owed a debt and you paid it...”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن أبي حازم ، عن أبي هريرة ﵁ ، عن النبي ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: من حج هذا البيت ولم يرفث ولم يفسق فرجع كان كيوم ولدته [أمه] .
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever performs the pilgrimage to this House, without obscenity or wrongdoing, returns as on the day his mother bore him.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن أبي وائل عن الصبي بن معبد
records.matn_ar: أنه أهل بالحج والعمرة فقال له [سلمان] بن ربيعة وزيد بن صوحان أنت أضل من بعيرك فسأل عمر ﵁ عن ذلك فقال هديت لسنة نبيك ﷺ.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Abu Wa'il, from al-Subayy b. Ma'bad:
records.matn_en: that he entered ihram for the pilgrimage and the 'umra together, and Ibn Rabi'a and Zayd b. Sawhan said to him: “You are more astray than your camel.” He asked 'Umar about that and he said: “You were guided to the sunna of your Prophet ﷺ.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن سعيد بن جُبَيْر ، عن ابن عمر ﵄
records.matn_ar: كان يدهن بالزيت قبل أن يحرم. قال فذكرت ذلك لإبراهيم فقال ما تصنع بقول سعيد حدثني الأسود عن عائشة قالت كأني أنظر إلى وبيص الطيب في مفارق رسول الله ﷺ وهو محرم.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, from Ibn 'Umar:
records.matn_en: [Ibn 'Umar] used to anoint himself with oil before entering ihram. He said: I mentioned that to Ibrahim and he said: “What do we do with the words of Sa'id? Al-Aswad narrated to me from 'A'isha: 'It is as if I see the gleam of perfume in the parting of the Messenger of God's hair while he was in ihram.'”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن هلال بن يساف عن أبي المثنى الحمصي عن أبي أُبَي ابن امرأة عبادة بن الصامت ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: كنا جلوسا عند النبي ﷺ فقال إنه سيجيء أمراء يؤخرون الصلاة تغشاهم أشياء حتى لا يصلوا الصلاة لوقتها فصلوا الصلاة لوقتها فقال رجل يا رسول الله ثم لا أصلي معهم قال نعم.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Hilal b. Yisaf, from Abu al-Muthanna al-Himsi, from Abu Ubayy, son of the wife of 'Ubada b. al-Samit, who said:
records.matn_en: We were sitting with the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: “Leaders will come who delay the prayer, distracted by other things so that they do not pray at its time; so pray the prayer at its time.” A man said: “O Messenger of God, then shall we pray with them?” He said: “Yes.”

narrators.en: Abu Ubayy, son of the wife of 'Ubada b. al-Samit
narrators.ar: ابي ابي ابن امراه عباده بن الصامت

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن هلال بن يساف عن أبي يحيى عن عبد الله بن عمرو ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: أتيت رسول الله ﷺ وهو يصلي جالسا فقلت يا رسول الله حدثت أنك قلت إن صلاة الرجل جالسا على النصف من صلاته قائما قال أجل ولكني لست كأحدكم.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Hilal b. Yisaf, from Abu Yahya, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, who said:
records.matn_en: I came to the Messenger of God ﷺ while he was praying sitting down, and I said: “O Messenger of God, I was told that you said: 'A man's prayer sitting is half the prayer of one standing.'” He said: “Yes, but I am not like any of you.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن رِبْعِي بن حِرَاش عن طارق بن عبد الله المحاربي قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: إذا صليت فلا تبزقن عن يمينك ولكن تلقاء شمالك إن كان فارغا أو تحت قدميك ثم قل به هكذا ، يعني [ادلكه] .
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Rib'i b. Hirash, from Tariq b. 'Abd Allah al-Muharibi, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “When you pray, do not spit to your right; spit to your left if it is empty, or beneath your feet, then rub it...”

records.matn_ar: قال طول القنوت في الصلاة أحب إلي يعني القيام.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن سالم بن أبي الجعد عن رجل من أهل الشام عن كعب بن مرة قال
records.matn_ar: سئل النبي ﷺ أي الليل أسمع قال جوف الليل الآخر ثم الصلاة مقبولة محضورة حتى يطلع الفجر ثم لا صلاة بعد الفجر حتى تكون الشمس قيد الرمح، أَو رمحين ثم الصلاة مقبولة محضورة حتى يقوم الظل قيام الرمح ثم لا صلاة حتى تزول الشمس ثم الصلاة مقبولة محضورة حتى تصلي تصلى العصر ثم لا صلاة حتى تغرب الشمس. قال وقال رسول الله ﷺ أيما امرأة مسلمة أعتقت مسلمة كانت فكاكها من النار مكان كل عضو وأيما رجل مسلم أعتق امرأتين مسلمتين كانتا فكاكه من النار مكان كل عضو عضوا.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from a man of Syria, from Ka'b b. Murra, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ was asked: “Which part of the night is the most audible [for supplication]?” He said: “The depth of the night, the last part; then the prayer is accepted and attended until the dawn breaks; then no prayer after dawn until the sun is a spear's length or two above the horizon; then the prayer is accepted and attended until the shadow stands at the height of a spear; then no prayer until the sun passes the zenith; then the prayer is accepted and attended until you pray the afternoon prayer; then no prayer until the sun sets.” He said: And the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Any Muslim woman who frees a Muslim woman, she will be her ransom from the Fire, each limb for a limb; and any Muslim man who frees two Muslim women, they will be his ransom from the Fire, each limb for two limbs.”

records.matn_ar: أنه كان يوتر حين يبقى من الليل نحو مما مضى من صلاة المغرب.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from 'Alqama, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud]:
records.matn_en: that he used to pray the witr when about as much of the night remained as had passed since the sunset prayer.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن رِبْعِي عن بعض أصحاب النبي ﷺ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: لا تتقدموا هذا الشهر حتى تروا الهلال وتكملوا العدة قبله ثم صوموا حتى تروا الهلال وأكملوا العدة قبله.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Rib'i, from one of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Do not anticipate this month until you see the new moon and complete the count before it; then fast until you see the new moon, and complete the count before it.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور [عن مجاهد عن حرملة بن إياس] عن أبي الخليل عن مولى لأبي قتادة عن أبي قتادة ﵁ عن النبي ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: صيام يوم عرفة كفارة سنتين سنة قبله وسنة بعده وصيام يوم عاشوراء كفارة سنة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Harmala b. Iyas, from Abu al-Khalil, from a freedman of Abu Qatada, from Abu Qatada, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “The fast of the day of 'Arafa expiates two years: the year before it and the year after; and the fast of the day of 'Ashura' expiates one year.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن ذر عن عبد الله بن شداد عن ابن عباس ﵄ قال:
records.matn_ar: قال رجل يا رسول الله إني أحدث نفسي بالشيء لأن أكزن أكون حممة أحب إلي من أن أتكلم به فقال رسول الله ﷺ اللهُ أَكْبَر اللهُ أَكْبَر رضي بالوسوسة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Dharr, from 'Abd Allah b. Shaddad, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
records.matn_en: A man said: “O Messenger of God, I tell myself something that I would rather be charcoal than speak of.” The Messenger of God said: “God is greatest, God is greatest! He is content with the whispering [of Satan].”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، [عن مَنْصُور بن حيان عن ابن بجاد عن جدته قالت: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: ردوا السائل ولو بظلف شاة محرق] .
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur b. Hayyan, from Ibn Bujad, from his grandmother, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Turn the beggar away, even with a burnt sheep's trotter” [text incomplete: dots in the source].

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى وأبو نُعَيْم قالا حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن رِبْعِي بن حِرَاش عن رجل عن علي ﵁ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: لا يؤمن رجل حتى يؤمن بالبعث بعد الموت والإيمان بالقدر.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Rib'i b. Hirash, from a man, from 'Ali, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “A man does not believe until he believes in the resurrection after death and believes in the divine decree.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة وأبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن منصور عن عبيد بن نسطاس عن أبي عبيدة عن عبد الله بن مسعود ﵁ ، قال
records.matn_ar: من أتى الجنازة فليأخذ بجوانبها الأربع فإنها من السنة ثم تطوع بعد إن شئت أو دع.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from 'Ubayd b. Nistas, from Abu 'Ubayda, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever comes to the funeral, let him take hold of its four sides, for that is from the sunna; then, after that, volunteer [to carry] if you wish or leave it.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم عن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد قال: حدثني علقمة عن أبي مسعود فلقيت أبا مسعود فحدثني عن رسول الله ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: من قرأ بالايتين بالآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid, who said: 'Alqama narrated to me, from Abu Mas'ud; then I met Abu Mas'ud and he narrated to me, from the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever recites the two verses from the end of Sura al-Baqara in a night, they will suffice him.”

records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God drove a hundred camels, among them a camel that had belonged to Abu Jahl.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم عن الأسود عن عائشة ﵂
records.matn_ar: أنها كانت تفتل القلائد لهدي رسول الله ﷺ.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha:
records.matn_en: that she used to make the garlands for the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of God ﷺ.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا وكيع عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور والأعمش ، عن إبراهيم عن الأسود عن عائشة ﵂
records.matn_ar: أن رسول الله ﷺ أهدى غنما مقلدة.
records.isnad_en: Waki' narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur and al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha:
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ sent sheep as offerings, garlanded.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم عن همام بن الحارث عن عدي بن حاتم ﵁ قال:
records.matn_ar: قلت يا رسول الله إنا نرسل كلابنا معلمة قال كل ما أمسكن عليك قال: قلت يا رسول الله وإن قتلن قال وإن قتلن ما لم يشركها كلب من غيرها قال: قلت يا رسول الله ما ترى بالمعراض قال ما خزق فكل وما أصاب بعرض فلا تأكل.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Humam b. al-Harith, from 'Adi b. Hatim, who said:
records.matn_en: I said: “O Messenger of God, we send out our trained dogs.” He said: “Eat of what they catch for you.” I said: “Even if they kill?” He said: “Even if they kill, so long as no dog from elsewhere joins them.” I said: “O Messenger of God, what do you say of the mi'rad [a headless arrow]?” He said: “What pierces, eat; what strikes with its side, do not eat.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن مجاهد عن مورق العجلي عن أبي ذر ﵁ ، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: من لاءمكم من خدمكم فأطعموهم مما تأكلون واكسوهم مما تلبسون ومن لم يلائمكم فبيعوه ولا تعذبوا عباد الله.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Muwarriq al-'Ijli, from Abu Dharr, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever of your servants suits you, feed them from what you eat and clothe them from what you wear; and whoever does not suit you, sell them, and do not punish the servants of God.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن يونس بن خباب عن طلق بن حبيب عن رجل كان يأتيه اليسر فرحل إلى الشام والمدينة قال
records.matn_ar: فصليت إلى جنب شيخ فقال لي ما أقدمك فقلت أصاب أبي اليسر فخرجت أطلب له فقال ما أعلم له إلا كلمات سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقولهن تعلمهن لعل الله يشفيه أو ينفعه: ربنا الله الذي في السماء، تقدس اسمك، أمرك في السماء والأرض، كما رحمتك في السماء اجعل رحمتك في الأرض، اغفر لنا ذنوبنا وخطأنا، رب الطيبين، أنزل رحمة من رحمتك، [وشفاء من شفائك] على هذا الوجع قال ففعله فبرأ.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Yunus b. Khabbab, from Talq b. Habib, from a man who [was afflicted with al-bashir and] traveled to Syria and Medina, who said:
records.matn_en: I prayed beside an old man, and he said to me: “What brought you?” I said: “My father is afflicted with [a swelling,] al-bashir, and I came out to seek [a remedy] for him.” He said: “I know of nothing for this except some words that I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say; say them, perhaps God will heal him or benefit him by them: 'Our Lord is God who is in the heaven, hallowed be Your name; Your command is in the heaven and the earth; as Your mercy is in the heaven, place Your mercy in the earth; forgive us our sins and faults, Lord of the good; send down a mercy from Your mercy upon this pain, that he may recover.'”

narrators.en: a man [afflicted with al-bashir] who traveled to Syria and Medina
narrators.ar: رجل كان يأتيه اليسر فرحل إلى الشام والمدينة
