records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن المنهال عن سعيد بن جُبَيْر ، عن ابن عباس قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ يعوذ الحسن والحسين، يقول: أعيذكما بكلمات الله التامة التامات، من كل شيطان وهامة، ومن كل عين لامة، ويقول، هكذا كان أبي إبراهيم ﷺ يعوذ ابنيه إسماعيل وإسحاق.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from al-Minhal, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to seek protection for al-Hasan and al-Husayn with these words, saying: “I commend you both to the perfect words of God, from every devil and vermin, and from every evil eye.” And he would say: “Thus my father Ibrahim used to seek protection for his two sons Isma'il and Ishaq.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور وليث عن مجاهد عن عقار بن المغيرة عن المغيرة بن شعبة ﵁ عن النبي ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: من اكتوى أو استرقى فلم يتوكل.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur and Layth, from Mujahid, from 'Iqar [sic, for Ghifar] b. al-Mughira, from al-Mughira b. Shu'ba, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever has himself cauterized or asks for a healing recitation has not put his trust [in God].”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم عن عمارة بن عمير عن عمته عن عائشة ﵂ قالت قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: إن أحق ما أكل الرجل من أطيب كسبه وإن ولد الرجل من أطيب كسبه.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from 'Umara b. 'Umayr, from his paternal aunt, from 'A'isha, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The most deserving thing a man can eat is from his purest earnings, and a man's children are from his purest earnings.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم عن الأسود عن عائشة ﵂
records.matn_ar: أنها كانت توقظ أهلها ليلة ثلاث وعشرين.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha:
records.matn_en: that she used to wake her family on the night of the twenty-third.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن مجاهد عن أسيد بن ظهير قال
records.matn_ar: كان أحدنا إذا استغنى عن أرضه أعطاها بالنصف والثلث، والربع،، ويشترط ثلاث جداول، والقصارة، قال والقصارة وما سقط من السنبل والجداول وما سقط من سقى الربيع، قال فكنا نعمل فيها بالحديد، قال وبما شاء الله، ويصيب منها حتى جاءنا رافع بن خديج، فقال: إن رسول الله ﷺ ينهاكم [عن أمر كان لكم نافعا، وطاعة الله، وطاعة رسوله أنفع لكم، إن رسول الله ﷺ ينهاكم] عن الحقل، من استغنى عن أرضه، فليمنحها أخاه، وينهاكم عن المزابنة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Usayd b. Zuhayr, who said:
records.matn_en: When one of us no longer needed his land, he would lease it for a half, a third or a quarter, stipulating the produce of the channels and of the threshing [chaff]. He said: the qusara is what falls from the ears, and the jadawil is what the spring irrigated. He said: We used to work it with iron tools and what God willed, and we got a share, until Rafi' b. Khadij came to us and said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ has forbidden you something that was beneficial, and obedience to the Messenger of God is more beneficial for you. The Messenger of God forbids you the haql: whoever has no need of his land, let him lend it to his brother. And he forbade you the muzabana.”

Contains editorial bracketed insertions

extra_refs.value: Rafi' b. Khadij (Companion), reporting the Prophet's prohibition (companion)

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن طلحة بن مصرف عن أنس بن مالك ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: مر رسول الله ﷺ بتمرة مطروحة في الطريق قال لولا أني أخشى أن تكون من الصدقة لأكلتها. ومر ابن عمر بتمرة مطروحة فأكلها.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Talha b. Musarrif, from Anas b. Malik, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God passed a date lying on the road and said: “Were it not that I fear it may be from charity, I would eat it.” And Ibn 'Umar passed a date lying on the road and ate it.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن أبي الضحى عن مسروق عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: لما نزلت آيات الخمر قام رسول الله ﷺ فتلاهن ثم حرم تجارة في الخمر.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: “When the verses on usury were revealed, the Messenger of God stood and recited them, then forbade trade in wine.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم عن الأسود عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: اشتريت جارية يقال لها بريرة فاشترط أهلها أن الولاء لهم فسألت النبي ﷺ فقال اشتريها فإن الولاء لولي النعمة لمن أعطاها الثمن. وكان لها زوج حر فخيرت فاختارت نفسها.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: I bought a slave girl called Barira, and her owners stipulated that the right of patronage be theirs. I asked the Prophet ﷺ and he said: “Buy her, for the right of patronage belongs to the one who bestows the favor [of freeing], to whoever pays the price.” She had a husband and was given the choice, and she chose herself.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن سالم بن أبي الجعد عن كُرَيْب عن ابن عَبَّاس ﵄ ، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: لو أن أحدكم قال حين يأتي أهله قال منصور أراه قال بسم الله اللهم جنبنا الشيطان وجنب الشيطان ما رزقتنا ويولد بينهما ولد لم يضره أبدا.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from Kurayb, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “If one of them, when he comes to his wife, says” (Mansur said: I think he said) “'In the name of God. O God, keep Satan away from us and keep Satan away from what You provide us,' and a child is born to them, Satan will never harm it.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن موسى بن عبد الله بن يزيد عن مولاة لعائشة عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: ما نظرت أو ما رأيت فرج رسول الله ﷺ قط.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Musa b. 'Abd Allah b. Yazid, from a freedwoman of 'A'isha, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: 'A'isha said: “I never looked at, or I never saw, the private part of the Messenger of God ﷺ.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم عن علقمة قال
records.matn_ar: اختلف إلى عبد الله في امرأة شهرا توفي عنها زوجها لم يدخل بها ولم يفرض لها صداقا قال لها مثل صداق نسائها وعليها العدة ولها الميراث. قال معقل بن سنان الأشجعي قضى رسول الله ﷺ في امرأة [منا] يقال لها بروع ابنة واشق من بني رؤاس بن كليب بمثل الذي قضيت به ففرح بذلك عبد الله.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from 'Alqama, who said:
records.matn_en: [A man] came repeatedly to 'Abd Allah for a month about a woman whose husband had died without consummating the marriage or fixing a dower for her. He said: “She has a dower like that of the women of her family, and she must observe the waiting period, and she has no inheritance.” Ma'qil b. Sinan al-Ashja'i said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ judged for a woman called Birwa' bint Washiq, of Banu Ruwas b. Kilab, with the like of what you have judged.” 'Abd Allah was delighted by that.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن إبراهيم عن علقمة قال: قال عبد الله
records.matn_ar: لعن الله الواشمات، [والمستوشمات] ، والمتنمصات، والمتفلجات للحسن المغيرات خلق الله قال: فبلغ ذلك امرأة من بني أسد يقال لها: أم يعقوب، فأتته فقالت: بلغني أنك لعنت ذيت وذيت فقال: نعم وما يمنعني أن ألعن من لعن رسول الله ﷺ وفي كتاب الله.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from 'Alqama, who said:
records.matn_en: 'Abd Allah said: “God has cursed women who tattoo and who have themselves tattooed, and women who file their teeth for beauty, altering God's creation.” That reached a woman of Banu Asad called Umm Ya'qub, who came to him and said: “It has reached me that you cursed so-and-so and so-and-so.” He said: “Yes, and what prevents me from cursing those whom the Messenger of God ﷺ cursed, and who are cursed in the Book of God?”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان عن منصور والأعمش ، عن سعد بن عبيدة عن أبي عبد الرحمن السلمي عن علي قال أبو نُعَيْم قال
records.matn_ar: كنا مع رسول الله ﷺ في بقيع الغرقد ، ولم يقله قَبِيصَة ، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: ما منكم من أحد إلا وقد كتب مقعده في الجنة، ومقعده في النار ، قالوا: يا رسول الله ، أفلا نتكل؟ فقال: اعملوا؛ فكل ميسر ، ثم قرأ {فأما من أعطى واتقى. وصدق بالحسنى. فسنيسره لليسرى. وأما من بخل واستغنى. وكذب بالحسنى. فسنيسره للعسرى} .
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur and al-A'mash, from Sa'd b. 'Ubayda, from Abu 'Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: We were with the Messenger of God ﷺ at Baqi' al-Gharqad. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “There is none of you but his seat in Paradise and his seat in the Fire has been written.” They said: “O Messenger of God, shall we not rely on that?” He said: “Work, for each is eased toward what he was created for.” Then he recited: {As for he who gives and fears God and believes in the best [reward], We will ease him toward ease. But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need and denies the best [reward], We will ease him toward difficulty} [al-Layl 92:5-10].

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن أبي وائل عن عبد الله ﵁ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: بئس ما لأحدهم يقول نسيت آية كيت وكيت بل هو نُسِّي.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Abu Wa'il, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “How bad it is for one of them to say: 'I forgot such and such a verse'; rather, he was made to forget it.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن سالم بن أبي الجَعْد ، عن أبيه عن عبد الله ﵁ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: ما منكم منكم من أحد إلا وقد وكل به قرينه من الجن وقرينه من الملائكة قالوا وإياك يا رسول الله قال وإياي ولكن الله أعانني عليه فأسلم فلا يأمرني إلا بخير.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from his father, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “There is none of you but a companion of the jinn and a companion of the angels has been appointed over him.” They said: “And you, O Messenger of God?” He said: “And me, but God helped me against him and he submitted, so he commands me only to good.”

narrators.en: Father of Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة وأبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان ، عن مَنْصُور عن عبد الله بن مرة عن عبد الله بن عمر ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: نهى رسول الله ﷺ عن النذر فقال إن النذر لا يرد شيئا إنما يستخرج به من الشحيح.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from 'Abd Allah b. Murra, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade making vows, saying: “A vow does not turn anything back; it only draws [something] out of the miser.”

records.matn_ar: آمين اسم من أسماء الله عز وجل. .

records.matn_ar: لقد أمرت بالسواك حتى خشيت على فمي.

records.matn_ar: رأيت عبد الله بن [أبي] أوفى يبزق دما ثم لم يتوضأ. قال أبو نُعَيْم في حديثه: وذلك بعدما ذهب بصره.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la and Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who all said: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ata', who said:
records.matn_en: I saw 'Abd Allah b. Abi Awfa spit blood and not perform ablution again. Abu Nu'aym said in his report: And that was after his sight had gone.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن عَطَاء عن قيس بن سكن قال
records.matn_ar: كان النبي ﷺ إذا سجد قال سجد وجهي للذي خلقه وشق سمعه وبصره وكان إذا سجد قال سجد وجهي متعفرا في التراب لخالقه وحق له.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ata', from Qays b. Sakan, who said:
records.matn_en: When the Prophet ﷺ prostrated he would say: “My face has prostrated to the One who created it and opened its hearing and sight.” And David, when he prostrated, would say: “My face has prostrated, rubbed in the dust, to its Creator, in the dust, and it is right for Him.”

records.matn_ar: أنه صلى في كسوف الشمس ركعتين.

records.matn_ar: أوصي امرءا [بأمه] وأوصي امرءا [بأمه] وأوصي امرءا [بأمه] [وأصي امرءا بأبيه وأوصي امرءا بأبيه وأصي امرءا] وأوصي امرءا بمولاه الذي يليه وإن كان عليه منه أذى يؤذيه.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ata', from his father, from 'Abd Allah [b. Mas'ud], who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “I commend a man to his father, I commend a man to his father, I commend a man to his father.” And from 'Abd Allah: “I commend a man to his mother, I commend a man to his mother, I commend a man to his mother; and I commend a man to his freed slave who is nearest to him, even if it harms him by harming.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن عَطَاء بن السائب عن حرب بن عبيد الله عن خال له من بكر بن وائل قال
records.matn_ar: أتى النبي ﷺ فسأله عن زكاة البقر والإبل والغنم فأخبره فلما ولى قال يا رسول الله أعشرهم قال إنما العشور على اليهود والنصارى وليس على المسلم عشور.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, from Harb b. 'Ubayd Allah, from a maternal uncle of his from Bakr b. Wa'il, who said:
records.matn_en: He came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him about the zakat on cattle, camels and sheep, and he told him. When he turned away, he said: “O Messenger of God, shall I take a tenth from them?” He said: “Tithes are only upon the Jews and Christians, and there is no tithe on a Muslim.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وعبيد الله وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن عَطَاء ، عن أبيه عن عبد الله بن عمرو قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: خصلتان لا يحصيهما رجل مسلم، إلا دخل الجنة وهما يسير ومن يعمل بهما قليل قالوا: وما هما يا رسول الله قال: يسبح الله في دبر كل صلاة مكتوبة عشرا، ويحمده عشرا، ويكبره عشرا، فتلك خمسون ومئة على اللسان، وألف وخمسمئة في الميزان، وإذا أوى إلى فراشه سبحه وحمده وكبره، مئة فتلك مئة باللسان على اللسان وألف في الميزان فأيكم يعمل في اليوم، والليلة ألفين وخمسمئة سيئة قالوا: يا رسول الله قالوا: يا رسول الله، وكيف لا يحصيهما قال: يأتي أحدكم الشيطان فيحدثه حتى ينومه ويأتيه فيقول فيقول: اذكر حاجة كذا وكذ احتى ينصرف، ولا يذكرها.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and 'Ubayd Allah and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Ata', from his father, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Two qualities which no Muslim man keeps count of but he enters Paradise; they are easy and few act upon them.” They said: “What are they, O Messenger of God?” He said: “You glorify God ten times after every obligatory prayer, praise Him ten times and magnify Him ten times: that is a hundred and fifty on the tongue and a thousand five hundred in the scale. And when he goes to his bed he glorifies, praises and magnifies a hundred: that is a hundred on the tongue and a thousand in the scale. Which of you commits two thousand five hundred wrongs in a day and night?” They said: “O Messenger of God, how is it that we do not keep count of them?” He said: “Satan comes to one of you and talks to him until he makes him sleep and forget, and says: Remember such and such a need, until he departs and does not remember them.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان عن عَطَاء بن السَّائب ، عن أبيه عن عبد الله بن عمرو قال
records.matn_ar: جاء رجل إلى النبي ﷺ يبايعه عىل على الهجرة قال يا رسول الله أتيتك أبايعك على الهجرة وتركت أبواي يبكيان قال فارجع إليهما فأضحكهما كما أبكيتهما.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, from his father, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, who said:
records.matn_en: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ to pledge allegiance to him for the emigration, and said: “O Messenger of God, I have come to pledge allegiance to you for the emigration, and I left my parents weeping.” He said: “Go back to them and make them laugh as you made them weep.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان عن عَطَاء بن السَّائب عن عرفجة عن عتبة بن فرقد عن رجل من أصحاب النبي ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: إذا جاء رمضان صفدت فيه الشياطين وغلقت فيه أبواب النار وفتحت فيه أبواب الجنة ونادى مناد يا باغي الخير هلم يا باغي الشر أقصر.

records.matn_en: “When Ramadan comes, the devils are chained in it, the doors of the Fire are locked, the doors of Paradise are opened, and a caller calls: O seeker of good, come forward; O seeker of evil, hold back.”

records.matn_en: It was said to him: “Shall we touch them, the Black Stone and the Yemeni corner?” He said: “I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'Wiping them removes sins.'”

narrators.ar: عبد الله بن عبيد بن عمير

flags: Transmitter doubts whether he narrated from his father
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن عَطَاء بن السَّائب عن سعيد بن جُبَيْر ، عن ابن عباس ﵄ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: إن البركة وسط القصعة فكلوا من نواحيها ولا تأكلوا من رأسها.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Blessing is in the middle of the bowl, so eat from its sides and do not eat from its top.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان عن عَطَاء بن السَّائب عن أبي عبد الرحمن السلمي قال
records.matn_ar: جمعت مع حذيفة ﵁ بالمدائن فسمعته يقول إنَّ الله عز وجل تعالى يقول {اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر} ألا إن القمر قد انشق على عهد رسول الله ﷺ ألا وإن الساعة قد اقتربت ألا وإن المضمار اليوم والسبق غدا. قال فقلت لأُبي غدا تجري الخيل قال إنك لغافل حتى سمعته يقول إن السابق من سبق إلى الجنة والغاية النار.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, from Abu 'Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami, who said:
records.matn_en: I attended the Friday prayer with Hudhayfa at al-Mada'in and heard him say: “God the Exalted says: {The Hour has come near, and the moon has split} [al-Qamar 54:1]. Beware: the moon split in the time of the Messenger of God. Beware: the Hour has come near. Beware: today is the training and tomorrow the race.” He said: I said to my father: “Tomorrow the horses race?” He said: “You are heedless!” until I heard him say: “The winner is the one who is first to Paradise, and the finish line is the Fire.”
flags: Chain start inherited from previous report
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Hudhayfa b. al-Yaman (Companion), in a sermon (companion)

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة وأبو نُعَيْم عن سفيان [عن عَطَاء بن السَّائب عن أم كلثوم ابنة علي قال
records.matn_ar: أتيتها بشيء من الصدقة فقالت احذر شبابنا فإن ميمون أو مهران مولى النبي ﷺ أخبرني أن النبي ﷺ قال: إنا أهل بيت نهينا عن الصدقة وإن موالينا من أنفسنا فلا تأكلوا الصدقة] . .
records.isnad_en: Qabisa and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, from Umm Kulthum, daughter of 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: [I brought her something of the charity, and she said: “Beware of our young men, for Maymun, or Mihran, the freedman of the Prophet ﷺ, informed me that the Prophet ﷺ said: 'We are a household forbidden charity, and our freedmen are of us; so do not eat charity.'”]
flags: Whole report restored by the editor in brackets
Doubt Maymun or Mihran
The cited authority is Umm Kulthum daughter of Ali

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by Maymun or Mihran, his freedman, via Umm Kulthum bint 'Ali) (prophetic)

groups.title_en: Hadith of Sufyan b. Sa'id, from al-Miqdam b. Shurayh
groups.title_ar: حديث سفيان بن سعيد عن المقدام بن شريح

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن المقدام بن شريح ، عن أبيه عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ إذا رجع أول ما يبدأ بالسواك.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Miqdam b. Shurayh, from his father, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: 'A'isha said: “When the Messenger of God ﷺ returned [home], the first thing he did was use the toothstick.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان عن المقدام بن شريح ، عن أبيه عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: إن كنت لأوتى بالإناء وأنا حائض وأشرب منه فيتناوله رسول الله ﷺ فيضع فاه من حيث شربت فيشرب وأوتى بالعرق فأنتهس منه فيتناوله رسول الله ﷺ فينتهس من حيث نهسته.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from al-Miqdam b. Shurayh, from his father, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: “I would be given a vessel while I was menstruating and drink from it, and the Messenger of God ﷺ would take it and place his mouth where I had drunk and drink; and I would be given a bone with meat and nibble at it, and the Messenger of God ﷺ would take it and nibble where I had nibbled.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة وأبو نُعَيْم عن سفيان عن المقدام بن شريح ، عن أبيه عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: ما بال (1) رسول الله ﷺ قائما منذ أنزل الله عليه القرآن.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa and Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, from Sufyan, from al-Miqdam b. Shurayh, from his father, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: “What is the matter with the Messenger of God ﷺ, that he has been standing [in prayer] since God sent down the Qur'an to him?”
flags: Sense of wording obscure translated tentatively
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

footnotes.ar: في المطبوع "ما زال" وبها يتغير المعنى ، والتصويب من مصادر التخريج ، انظر "مسند أحمد" (25045 و25596 و25787) .
footnotes.en: In the printed [edition] it reads 'ma zala' ('he kept on'), which changes the meaning; the correction is from the sources of the takhrij; see Musnad Ahmad (25045, 25596 and 25787).

groups.title_en: From the hadith of Sufyan, from Abu 'Ali, the carpet seller
groups.title_ar: من حديث سفيان عن أبي علي بياع الأنماط

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان عن أبي علي بياع الأنماط عن جعفر بن قثم بن عباس أو ابن تمام بن عباس ، عن أبيه قال قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: ما لي أراكم تأتونني قلحا استاكوا فلولا أن أشق على أمتي لفرضت عليهم السواك كما فرضت عليهم الصلاة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu 'Ali, the carpet seller, from Ja'far b. Qatham b. 'Abbas, or Ibn Tamam b. 'Abbas, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Why do I see you coming to me with yellow teeth? Use the toothstick. Were it not that I would burden my community, I would make the toothstick obligatory for them as I made the prayer obligatory.”

narrators.en: Father of Ja'far b. Qatham b. 'Abbas, or Ibn Tamam b. 'Abbas
Ja'far b. Qatham b. 'Abbas, or Ibn Tamam b. 'Abbas

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن أبي علي بياع الأنماط عن أبي عثمان ، عن أبي هريرة ﵁ ، قال
records.matn_ar: أمرني رسول الله ﷺ أن أنادي لا صلاة إلا بقراءة فاتحة الكتاب فما زاد. قال وسمعت أبا عثمان يقول رأيت عمر يمد يديه في القنوت. سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار .
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu 'Ali, the carpet seller, from Abu 'Uthman, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ commanded me to call out: There is no prayer except with recitation: the Opening of the Book and more.” He said: And I heard Abu 'Uthman say: I saw 'Umar stretch out his hands in the qunut.
flags: Report includes a second observation by Abu Uthman
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Abu Hurayra (Companion), reporting the Prophet's command; with an observation of 'Umar's practice (companion)

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: كان لا يأكل طعاما إلا استن فقال لأن أكون استقبلت من أمري من أمري ما استدبرت [كان] أحب إلي من وصيفين.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: He would not eat food without first using the toothstick, and said: “For me to take from my affair what I had turned my back on is dearer to me than two [young] servants.”
flags: Wording unclear translated tentatively
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic
Contains editorial bracketed insertions

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ أن النبي ﷺ
records.matn_ar: أمر عمر ﵁ أن يغسل ذكره ويتوضأ ويرقد.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, that the Prophet ﷺ
records.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ commanded 'Umar to wash his private part, perform ablution and sleep.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن نافع عن ابن عمر ﵄
records.matn_ar: أنه كان يمسح رأسه مرة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar:
records.matn_en: that he used to wipe his head once.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن سليمان بن يَسَار عن عراك بن مالك ، عن أبي هريرة ﵁ ، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: ليس على المسلم في فرسه ولا عبده صدقة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Sulayman b. Yasar, from 'Irak b. Malik, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “A Muslim owes no charity on his horse or his slave.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان [عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: لكل غادر لواء يعرف به يوم القيامة] .
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Every treacherous person will have a banner by which he is known on the Day of Resurrection.”
flags: Whole report restored by the editor in brackets

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: اتخذ رسول الله ﷺ خاتما من ذهب، فاتخذ الناس خواتيمهم من ذهب، فقال رسول الله ﷺ: إني اتخذت خاتما من ذهب فاتخذ الناس خواتيم من ذهب، فنبذه، وقال: إني لست ألبسه أبدا فنبذ الناس خواتيمهم.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God made a ring of gold, and the people made rings of gold. The Messenger of God said: “I made a ring of gold, and the people made rings of gold.” He threw it away and said: “I will never wear it.” So the people threw away their rings.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا عبيد الله بن موسى وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن عبد الله بن عمر ﵄ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ وأشار إلى المشرق
records.matn_ar: وإن الفتنة من هاهنا وإن الفتنة من هاهنا ثلاثا من حيث يطلع قرنا شيطان.
records.isnad_en: 'Ubayd Allah b. Musa and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said, pointing to the east: “Indeed the trial comes from here, the trial comes from here,” three times, “from where the two horns of Satan rise.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم عن سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار سمعت ابن عمر ﵁ يقول
records.matn_ar: وقت رسول الله ﷺ لأهل الشام الجحفة ولأهل المدينة ذا الحليفة ولأهل نجد قرنا. قال ابن عمر: هذا سمعته من رسول الله ﷺ وسمعت بعد من رسول الله ولأهل اليمن يلملم.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, who said: I heard Ibn 'Umar say:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ fixed al-Juhfa for the people of Syria, Dhu al-Hulayfa for the people of Medina, and Qarn for the people of Najd.” Ibn 'Umar said: “This I heard from the Messenger of God, and I heard afterward from the Messenger of God: and for the people of Yemen, Yalamlam.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار قال: سمعت ابن عمر يقول قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: إن اليهود إذا سلموا عليكم يقولون السام عليكم فردوا عليهم وعليكم.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, who said: I heard Ibn 'Umar say, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “When the Jews greet you they say 'al-Sam 'alaykum' [death be upon you]; so answer them: 'and upon you.'”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: أسلم سالمها الله وغفار غفر الله لها وعصية عصت الله ورسوله.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Aslam, may God give them safety; Ghifar, may God forgive them; and 'Usayya disobeyed God and His Messenger.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار قال
records.matn_ar: رأى ابن عمر ﵁ شيئا وهو في الصلاة فظن أنها عقرب فأهوى إليها برجله ، فإذا هي قطنة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, who said:
records.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar saw something while he was praying and thought it was a scorpion, and he reached out to it with his foot, and it was a piece of cotton.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄
records.matn_ar: أن النبي ﷺ كان يصلي على راحلته أينما توجهت به.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar:
records.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray on his mount in whatever direction it faced.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا عبيد الله وأبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ يأتي قباء ماشيا وراكبا.
records.isnad_en: 'Ubayd Allah and Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to come to Quba', walking and riding.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: نهى رسول الله ﷺ أن يلبس المحرم ثوبا مصبوغا بورس أو بزعفران.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade the pilgrim in ihram to wear a garment dyed with wars or saffron.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: إذا لم يجد المحرم نعلين فليلبس خفين وليقطع أسفل من الكعبين.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “When the pilgrim in ihram does not find sandals, let him wear leather socks and cut them below the ankles.”

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: سئل رسول الله ﷺ عن الضب قال لا آكله ولا أحرمه.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ was asked about the dabb [spiny-tailed lizard] and said: “I do not eat it, and I do not forbid it.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى وأبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: من اقتنى كلبا إلا كلب صيد أو ماشية انتقص من عمله كل يوم قيراطان.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la and Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever keeps a dog, except a hunting dog or a herding dog, two qirats are deducted from his deeds each day.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ عن النبي ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: من اشترى طعاما فلا يبعه حتى يقبضه.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has taken possession of it.”
flags: Abu Nu aym raises it to the Prophet the others may not
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن عبد الله بن عمر ﵄ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: من ابتاع عبدا وله مال فماله للبائع إلا أن يشترط المبتاع.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever buys a slave who has property, the property belongs to the seller, unless the buyer stipulates [otherwise].”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم قال: حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال: قال رجل للنبي ﷺ
records.matn_ar: إني رجل أخدع في البيع قال إذا بعت فقل لا خلابة فكان الرجل يقوله.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: A man said to the Prophet ﷺ: “I am a man who is deceived in sales.” He said: “When you sell, say: No deception.” And the man used to say it.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى وأبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة عن سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: نهى رسول الله ﷺ عن بيع الولاء وعن هبته.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la and Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade selling the right of patronage and giving it away.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقبيصة قالا حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن عبد الله بن عمر قال
records.matn_ar: كنا نتقي الكلام عند الانبساط إلى النساء مخافة أن ينزل فينا القرآن فلما توفي رسول الله ﷺ تكلمنا.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: “We used to avoid speaking [freely] in relaxed talk with women, for fear that a Qur'anic revelation would come down about us; when the Messenger of God died, we spoke.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن عبد الله بن عمر ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: نهى رسول الله ﷺ أن يتناجى اثنان دون الثالث.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade two people to converse privately leaving out the third.
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله بن دينار عن ابن عمر ﵄ قال
records.matn_ar: كان النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يبايعنا على السمع والطاعة ثم يلقنهم فيما استطعتم.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to take our pledge to hear and obey, and he would prompt them: “as far as you are able.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان حدثنا عبد الله بن دينار قال
records.matn_ar: لما اجتمع الناس على عبد الملك بن مروان كتب إليه ابن عمر أما بعد ، فإني أقر بالسمع والطاعة لعبد الله لعبد الملك أمير المؤمنين على سنة الله وسنة رسوله فيما استطعت استطعنا ، وقد أقر بني بمثل ذلك ، والسلام.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us; 'Abd Allah b. Dinar narrated to us, who said:
records.matn_en: When the people agreed upon 'Abd al-Malik b. Marwan, Ibn 'Umar wrote to him: “To proceed: I affirm hearing and obedience to the servant of God 'Abd al-Malik, Commander of the Faithful, according to the Sunna of God and the Sunna of His Messenger as far as we are able; and my sons have affirmed the like of that. Peace.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

groups.title_en: From the hadith of Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Najih
groups.title_ar: من حديث سفيان عن عبد الله بن أبي نجيح

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان عن عبد الله ابن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد قال
records.matn_ar: الاستنشاق شطر الوضوء.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
records.matn_en: “Snuffing water is half of the ablution.”
flags: Unnumbered second hadith within printed number 193
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، عن سفيان عن ابن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد {إنا انزلناه أنزلناه في ليلة القدر}
records.matn_ar: قال ليلة الحكم.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, concerning {Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Decree} [al-Qadr 97:1]:
records.matn_en: {Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Decree} [al-Qadr 97:1]: he said: the Night of Judgment (al-hukm).
flags: Unnumbered third hadith within printed number 193
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الله ابن أبي نجيح وأيوب عن مجاهد عن عبد الرحمن ابن أبي ليلى عن كعب بن عجرة قال
records.matn_ar: مر بي رسول الله ﷺ، وأنا أوقد تحت قدر لي، فقال: أيؤذيك هوام رأسك؟ قلت: نعم. قال: فدعا حجاما فحلقه، ، ثم قال: صم ثلاثة أيام، أو أطعم فرقا في ستة مساكين، أو انسك شاة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Najih and Ayyub, from Mujahid, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, from Ka'b b. 'Ujra, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ passed by me while I was lighting a fire under a pot of mine, and said: “Are the vermin of your head troubling you?” I said: “Yes.” He called a barber who shaved my head, then said: “Fast three days, or feed six poor people half a faraq, or sacrifice a sheep.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by Ka'b b. 'Ujra) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن أيوب وابن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد عن عبد الرحمن ابن أبي ليلى عن علي ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: أمرني النبي ﷺ أن أصدق بجلال البدن التي نحرت وبجلودها.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Ayyub and Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, from 'Ali, who said:
records.matn_en: 'Ali said: “The Prophet ﷺ commanded me to give in charity the covers of the sacrificed camels, or their hides.”
flags: Prophetic command reported by Ali
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا يعلى حدثنا سفيان عن ابن أبي نجيح عن جابر ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: كنا نبيع أمهات الأولاد على عهد رسول الله ﷺ.
records.isnad_en: Ya'la narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Jabir, who said:
records.matn_en: “We used to sell mothers of children in the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان حدثنا ابن أبي نجيح ابن أبي ليلى عن عبد الله بن كثير عن أبي المنهال عن ابن عباس ﵄ قال:
records.matn_ar: قدم رسول الله ﷺ المدينة وهم يسلفون في الثمار السنة والسنتين، فقال: رسول الله ﷺ: من أسلف فليسلف في كيل معلوم ووزن معلوم. سفيان عن عثمان بن المغيرة الثقفي .
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us; Ibn Abi Najih narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Kathir, from Abu al-Minhal, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ came to Medina when they were paying in advance for fruit for a year or two, and the Messenger of God said: “Whoever pays in advance, let him pay in advance in a known measure and a known weight.”
flags: English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic
Printed text garbled in the isnad reading follows the likely intended names

records.isnad_ar: عن وكيع عن سفيان عن عثمان بن المغيرة الثقفي عن علي بن ربيعة الوالبي عن أسماء بن الحكم الفزاري عن علي بن أبي طالب ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: كنت إذا سمعت من رسول الله ﷺ حديثا نفعني الله عز وجل بما شاء منه، وإذا حدثني عنه غيره استحلفته فإذا حلف لي صدقته، وأن وإن أبا بكر حدثني وصدق أبو بكر ، أنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: ما من رجل يذنب ذنبا فيتوضأ فيحسن الوضوء ثم يصلي ركعتين ثم ويستغفر الله إلا غفر له.
records.isnad_en: From Waki', from Sufyan, from 'Uthman b. al-Mughira al-Thaqafi, from 'Ali b. Rabi'a al-Walibi, from Asma' b. al-Hakam al-Fazari, from 'Ali b. Abi Talib, who said:
records.matn_en: 'Ali b. Abi Talib said: “When I heard a hadith from the Messenger of God, God benefited me by it as He willed; and when someone else narrated it to me, I made him swear, and when he swore I believed him. And Abu Bakr narrated to me, and Abu Bakr spoke the truth: 'There is no man who commits a sin, then performs the ablution well, prays two rak'as and asks God's forgiveness, but he is forgiven.'”
flags: Report nested Ali from Abu Bakr from the Prophet
Compiler names Abd Allah b Abi Shayba as his source for Waki
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Abu Bakr (Companion), reporting the Prophet ﷺ, through 'Ali (companion)

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة ، حدثنا سفيان عن عثمان الثقفي عن سالم بن أبي الجَعْد عن ابن الحنفية قال:
records.matn_ar: قال رسول الله ﷺ لبلال أرحنا بالصلاة.
records.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Uthman al-Thaqafi, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from Ibn al-Hanafiyya, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said to Bilal: “Give us rest with the prayer.”
flags: Mursal report by successor
English matn carried over from the manuscript text 29701 after collation of the arabic

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by Ibn al-Hanafiyya) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو نُعَيْم وقَبِيصَة قالا حدثنا سفيان عن أبي اليقظان عن زاذان عن جرير بن عبد الله.
records.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym and Qabisa narrated to us, who both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Yaqzan, from Zadhan, from Jarir b. 'Abd Allah
records.matn_en: [The chain breaks off in the printed text; no matn follows. It ends with the name of the Companion Jarir b. 'Abd Allah.]

No matn in source

groups.title_en: Part Two: the transmission of Muhammad b. Yusuf al-Firyabi from al-Thawri
groups.title_ar: القسم الثاني: رواية محمد بن يوسف الفريابي عن الثوري

records.isnad_ar: عن زيد بن طلحة التيمي قال: سمعت ابن عباس ﵄
records.matn_ar: وقرأ على جنازة بفاتحة الكتاب وسورة جهر بالقراءة وقال إنما جهرت بالقراءة لأعلمكم أنها سنة والإمام يخففها يخفيها.
records.isnad_en: From Zayd b. Talha al-Taymi, who said: I heard Ibn 'Abbas, may God be pleased with them both,
records.matn_en: [Ibn 'Abbas] recited over a funeral the Opening of the Book and a sura, reciting aloud, and he said: “I only recited aloud to let you know that it is sunna.” [Variant: the imam makes it light / makes it inaudible.]
flags: The isnad continues the chain of the preface from hadathana Sufyan

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا عبيد الله عن الزهري عن سعيد بن المسيب ، عن أبي هريرة ﵁ ، قال
records.matn_ar: كبر رسول الله ﷺ على النجاشي أربع تكبيرات.
records.isnad_en: 'Ubayd Allah narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said the takbir over al-Najashi four times.

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (practice reported by Abu Hurayra) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: عن الأسود بن قيس عن نبيح عن جابر بن عبد الله ﵁ قال
records.matn_ar: لما كان يوم أحد حمل القتلى ليدفنوا في البقيع فنادى منادي رسول الله ﷺ إن رسول الله ﷺ يأمركم أن تدفنوا القتلى في مضاجعهم بعدما حملت أبي وخالي لندفنهم فردوا.
records.isnad_en: From al-Aswad b. Qays, from Nubayh, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah, who said:
records.matn_en: On the day of Uhud, the slain were carried to be buried in al-Baqi', and the herald of the Messenger of God ﷺ called: “The Messenger of God ﷺ commands you to bury the slain where they fell,” after I had carried my father and my maternal uncle to bury them; so they were returned.

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Jabir b. 'Abd Allah (Companion), reporting an order of the Prophet ﷺ (companion)

records.isnad_ar: عن سالم قال: أخبرني أبو حازم قال
records.matn_ar: رأيت الحسين بن علي ﵄ يقول لسعيد بن العاص حين مات الحسن تقدم فلولا أنها سنة لتقدمت ما تقدمت.
records.isnad_en: From Salim; Abu Hazim informed me, who said:
records.matn_en: I saw al-Husayn b. 'Ali say to Sa'id b. al-'As when al-Hasan died: “Step forward [to lead the prayer]; were it not that it is the sunna I would not have stepped forward.”

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Abu Hazim (Successor), reporting an incident involving al-Husayn (successor)

records.isnad_ar: عن خالد الحذاء عن أم الهذيل عن أم عطية قالت
records.matn_ar: نهينا عن اتباع الجنائز ولم يعزم علينا.
records.isnad_en: From Khalid al-Hadhdha', from Umm al-Hudhayl, from Umm 'Atiyya, who said:
records.matn_en: “We were forbidden to follow funerals, but it was not made binding upon us.”

records.isnad_ar: عن عثمان عن زاذان عن جرير
records.matn_ar: أن النبي ﷺ قال: اللحد لنا والشق لغيرنا.
records.isnad_en: From 'Uthman, from Zadhan, from Jarir:
records.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The lahd [niche grave] is for us and the shaqq [trench grave] is for others.”

records.isnad_ar: عن حبيب بن أبي ثابت عن أبي وائل عن أبي هياج الأسدي قال:
records.matn_ar: قال لي علي ﵁﵇ أبعثك على ما بعثني رسول الله ﷺ ألا تترك قبرا مشرفا إلا سويته ولا تمثالا إلا طمسته.
records.isnad_en: From Habib b. Abi Thabit, from Abu Wa'il, from Abu al-Hayyaj al-Asadi, who said:
records.matn_en: 'Ali, may God be pleased with him, said to me: “I send you on what the Messenger of God ﷺ sent me: do not leave a raised grave without leveling it, nor an image without effacing it.”

records.isnad_ar: عن سليمان الشيباني عن الشعبي عن ابن عباس ﵄
records.matn_ar: أن النبي ﷺ صلى على قبر بعد ما دفن.
records.isnad_en: From Sulayman al-Shaybani, from al-Sha'bi, from Ibn 'Abbas:
records.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed over a grave after [the person] had been buried.

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (practice reported by Ibn 'Abbas) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: عن علقمة بن مرثد عن سليمان بن بريدة ، عن أبيه قال
records.matn_ar: أتى النبي ﷺ قبرا فجلس عليه، وجلس الناس حوله، فجعل يحرك أصبعه ورأسه كالمخاطب. فقام فجعل يبكي فاستقبله عمر ﵁، فقال: ما يبكيك؟ قال إني استأذنت ربي عز وجل ربي في قبر أم محمد فأذن لي وسألته الاستغفار فأبى علي، فأدركتني رحمتها فبكيت. قال: فما رأيت ساعة أكثر باكيا من تلك الساعة.
records.isnad_en: From 'Alqama b. Marthad, from Sulayman b. Buraida, from his father, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ came to a grave and sat by it, and the people sat around him. He kept moving his finger and his head as if addressing someone. Then he rose weeping, and 'Umar met him and said: “What makes you weep?” He said: “I asked my Lord, Mighty and Majestic, for permission [to visit] the grave of Muhammad's mother, and He permitted me; and I asked Him to allow me to seek forgiveness [for her], and He refused me; so her mercy overtook me and I wept.” He said: I never saw a time when more people were weeping than that time.

records.isnad_ar: حدثنا عن عبد الله بن عثمان عن عبد الرحمن بن بهمان عن عبد الرحمن بن حسان بن ثابت ، عن أبيه قال
records.matn_ar: لعن رسول الله ﷺ زوارات القبور.
records.isnad_en: [Sufyan] narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Uthman, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Bahman, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Hassan b. Thabit, from his father, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ cursed the women who visit graves.

narrators.en: Father of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Hassan b. Thabit

narrators.ar: عبد الرحمن بن حسان بن ثابت

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Hassan b. Thabit (Companion), reporting the Prophet ﷺ (companion)

records.isnad_ar: عن علقمة بن مرثد عن ابن بريدة ، عن أبيه قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ يعلمهم إذا خرجوا إلى المقابر أن يقولوا سلام عليرك عليكم مأهل الديار من المؤمنين والمسلمين وإنا إن شاء الله بكم لاحقون أنتم لنا فرطا ونحن لكم تبعا نسأل الله لنا ولكم العافية.
records.isnad_en: From 'Alqama b. Marthad, from Ibn Buraida, from his father, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to teach them, when they went out to the graveyards, to say: “Peace be upon you, O people of the abodes, among the believers and the Muslims; we shall, God willing, join you; you are our forerunners and we are your followers; we ask God for well-being for us and for you.”

records.isnad_ar: عن شريك بن عبد الله بن أبي نمر قال: سمعت عَطَاء بن يسار قال
records.matn_ar: كان رسول الله ﷺ يخرج ليلة عائشة ﵂ إلى البقيع فيقول السلام عليكم أهل دار قوم مؤمنين وإنا بكم إن شاء الله لاحقون وإنا وإياكم فيما توعدون غدا مؤجلون اللهم اغفر لأهل البقيع مرتين إو أو ثلاثا.
records.isnad_en: From Sharik b. 'Abd Allah b. Abi Namir, who said: I heard 'Ata' b. Yasar say, who said:
records.matn_en: On the night of 'A'isha [his turn] the Messenger of God ﷺ would go out to al-Baqi' and say: “Peace be upon you, abode of a believing people; we shall, God willing, join you; and we and you are promised for tomorrow, deferred. O God, forgive the people of al-Baqi'” twice or three times.

narrators.en: Sharik b. 'Abd Allah b. Abi Namir
narrators.ar: شريك بن عبد الله بن ابي نمر

flags: Mursal report by successor

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: 'Ata' b. Yasar (Successor), reporting the Prophet's practice (successor)

records.isnad_ar: عن هشام بن عروة ، عن أبيه عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: بعث لي أبي أي يوم توفي النبي ﷺ فقلت يوم الاثنين قال إني أرجوا أن أموت فيه فمات من عشيته ودفن ليلا ﵁.
records.isnad_en: From Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: [Abu Bakr] sent for me and said: “On what day did the Prophet ﷺ die?” I said: “Monday.” He said: “I hope to die on it.” He died that evening and was buried at night, may God be pleased with him.
flags: Text continues with a comment on the burial night by the compiler

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: 'A'isha (Companion), reporting the death of Abu Bakr (companion)

records.isnad_ar: عن الأعمش عبد اللهعن أبي سفيان عن جابر قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: يبعث كل عبد على ما مات عليه.
records.isnad_en: From al-A'mash, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Every servant will be raised in the state in which he died.”

records.isnad_ar: عن سليمان التيمي عن أنس بن مالك ﵁ عن النبي ﷺ قال:
records.matn_ar: مررت بموسى وهو قائم يصلي في قبره.
records.isnad_en: From Sulayman al-Taymi, from Anas b. Malik, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “I passed by Musa, who was standing in prayer in his grave.”

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by Anas b. Malik) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: عن عاصم عن القاسم بن محمد عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: رأيت رسول الله ﷺ يقبل عثمان بن مظعون وهو ميت والدمع يسيل على لحيته.
records.isnad_en: From 'Asim, from al-Qasim b. Muhammad, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ kiss 'Uthman b. Maz'un while he was dead, with tears running down upon his beard.

records.isnad_ar: عن أبي إسحاق عن ناجية بن كعب عن علي بن أبي طالب ﵁ قال:
records.matn_ar: لما مات أبو طالب أتيت النبي ﷺ فقلت: إن عمك الشيخ الضال قد مات، فمن يواريه؟ قال اذهب فوار أباك ولا تحدثن شيئا حتى تأتيني قال فأتيته فأمرني فاغتسلت ثم دعا لي بدعوات ما يسرني أن لي بهن ما على الأرض من شيء.
records.isnad_en: From Abu Ishaq, from Najiya b. Ka'b, from 'Ali b. Abi Talib, who said:
records.matn_en: When Abu Talib died I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “Your uncle, the old and misguided man, has died; who will bury him?” He said: “Go and bury your father, and do nothing new until you come back to me.” I came to him and he ordered me, so I bathed, and he supplicated for me with supplications dearer to me than everything on earth.

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: 'Ali (Companion), reporting an incident of the Prophet ﷺ (companion)

records.isnad_ar: عن إسماعيل بن أبي خالد عن أبي بردة عن عائشة ﵂ قالت
records.matn_ar: أغمي على النبي ﷺ وهو في حجري فجغلت فجعلت أمسحه وأدعوا له بالشفاء فلما أفاق قال بل أسأل الله الرفيق الأعلى الأسعد مع جبريل ﵇ وإسرافيل وميكائيل عليهم السلام.
records.isnad_en: From Isma'il b. Abi Khalid, from Abu Burda, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ fainted while his head was in my lap, and I began to wipe him and supplicate for his healing. When he recovered he said: “Rather, I ask God for the highest companionship, the most blessed, with Jibril, Israfil and Mika'il, peace be upon them.”

records.isnad_ar: عن مَنْصُور عن أبي وائل قال
records.matn_ar: دخل معاوية على أبي هاشم بن عتبة بن ربيعة فقال يا خال ما يبكيك أوجع يشئزك أم حرص على الدنيا قال كل لا ولكن عهد إلي رسول الله ﷺ عهدا لم آخذ به قال يا أبا هاشم إنها ستدركك أموال يأتي يؤتى بها أقوام وإنما يكفيك من جمع المال خادم ومركب في سبيل الله عز وجل.
records.isnad_en: From Mansur, from Abu Wa'il, who said:
records.matn_en: Mu'awiya came in to Abu Hashim b. 'Utba b. Rabi'a and said: “Uncle, what makes you weep? Is it pain that disturbs you or desire for the world?” He said: “Neither; but the Messenger of God ﷺ made a covenant with me that I did not take up. He said: 'O Abu Hashim, wealth will reach you, which will be brought to some people; what suffices you of collecting wealth is a servant and a mount in the path of God, Mighty and Majestic.'”

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Abu Wa'il (Successor), reporting an incident involving a Companion (successor)

records.isnad_ar: عن موسى بن عبيدة عن إياس بن سلمة ، عن أبيه قال
records.matn_ar: كنا مع رسول الله ﷺ في جنازة كنا مع رسول الله ﷺ في جنازة، فأثنى فأثني عليها، فقال رسول الله ﷺ: وجبت، قال فسئل يا رسول الله، ما وجبت؟ قال: الملائكة شهداء الله في السماء وأنتم شهداء الله في الأرض، فإذا شهدتم وجبت، ثم قرأ {وقل اعملوا فسيرى الله عملكم ورسوله والمؤمنون} . وأتي بجنازة فقال هل ترك شيئا قالوا لا قال هل ترك عليه دينا قالوا نعم دينارين قال صلوا على صاحبكم فقام أبو قتادة بن ربعي فقال يا رسول الله هما علي فصلى عليه رسول الله ﷺ وكان رسول الله ﷺ كلما رأى أبا قتادة قال له ما فعل الديناران.
records.isnad_en: From Musa b. 'Ubayda, from Iyas b. Salama, from his father, who said:
records.matn_en: We were with the Messenger of God ﷺ at a funeral; it was praised, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “It is obligatory.” It was asked: “O Messenger of God, what is obligatory?” He said: “The angels are God's witnesses in heaven and you are God's witnesses on earth; when you bear witness, it is obligatory.” Then he recited {And say, 'Do [as you will], for God will see your deeds, and [so will] His Messenger and the believers'} [al-Tawba 9:105]. Another funeral was brought and he said: “Did he leave anything?” They said: “No.” He said: “Did he leave a debt?” They said: “Yes, two dinars.” He said: “Pray over your companion.” Abu Qatada b. Rib'i stood and said: “O Messenger of God, they are upon me.” So the Messenger of God ﷺ prayed over him; and whenever the Messenger of God ﷺ saw Abu Qatada he would say to him: “What of the two dinars?”
flags: Two incidents joined in one report

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by Salama b. al-Akwa') (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: عن زبيد عن إبراهيم عن مسروق عن عبد الله بن مسعود ﵁ قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: ليس منا من ضرب الخدود وشق الجيوب ودعا دعوى الجاهلية.
records.isnad_en: From Zubayd, from Ibrahim, from Masruq, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “He is not of us who strikes the cheeks, tears the garments and calls with the call of the Jahiliyya.”

records.isnad_ar: عن محمد بن عبد الرحمن عن المقبري عن عبد الرحمن بن مهران ، عن أبي هريرة ﵁ ، قال
records.matn_ar: لا تضربوا على علي فسطاطا ولا تتبعوني بمجمرة تمشوا علي بمجمر وأسرعوا بي المشي فإني سمعت رسول اللهِ ﷺ يقول إذا وضع الرجل الصالح على سريره قال قدموني قدموني وإذا وضع الرجل السوء على سريره قال يا ويله أين تذهبون بي.
records.isnad_en: From Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from al-Maqburi, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Mihran, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
records.matn_en: “Do not pitch a tent over me, and do not follow me with an incense burner; walk quickly with me; for I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'When a righteous man is laid on his bier he says: Take me forward, take me forward; and when an evil man is laid on his bier he says: Woe to him, where are you taking me?'”

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Abu Hurayra (Companion), in a deathbed instruction (companion)

records.isnad_ar: عن عبد الرحمن بن زياد عن رجل قد سماه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ
records.matn_ar: من بث لم يصبر ثم قرأ {إنما أشكوا بثي وحزني إلى الله} .
records.isnad_en: From 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ziyad, from a man whom he named [not named in the text], who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever pours out his grief has not been patient.” Then he recited {I only complain of my suffering and my grief to God} [Yusuf 12:86].

narrators.en: a man whom he named (not named in the text)
